VBA MACRO modWorkbookIndex.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modWorkbookIndex'

' ============================================================
' GENERATE SHEET INDEX
' ============================================================
Public Sub GenerateSheetIndex(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Sheets("Sheet_Index").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    Dim idx As Worksheet
    Set idx = wb.Sheets.Add(Before:=wb.Sheets(1))

    idx.Name = "Sheet_Index"

    Dim totalSheets As Integer
    totalSheets = wb.Sheets.count - 1

    ' top spacing
    idx.Rows(1).RowHeight = 34
    idx.Rows(2).RowHeight = 20
    idx.Rows(3).RowHeight = 24

    ' =========================================================
    ' HEADER
    ' =========================================================

    With idx.Range("A1:G1")

        .Merge

        .Value = "SHEET INDEX DASHBOARD  •  " & totalSheets & " SHEETS"

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

        .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
        .Font.Size = 15
        .Font.Bold = True

        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

        .Interior.Color = RGB(36, 74, 140)

    End With

    With idx.Range("A2:G2")

        .Merge

        .Value = "Click sheet name to open  •  Use delete button to remove sheet"

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

        .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
        .Font.Size = 9
        .Font.Italic = True

        .Font.Color = RGB(90, 90, 90)

        .Interior.Color = RGB(240, 244, 250)

    End With

    ' =========================================================
    ' TABLE HEADER
    ' =========================================================

    Dim hdr As Variant

    hdr = Array( _
        "No", _
        "Sheet Name", _
        "Used Rows", _
        "Used Cols", _
        "Protection", _
        "Visibility", _
        "Action")

    Dim i As Integer

    For i = 0 To 6

        With idx.Cells(3, i + 1)

            .Value = hdr(i)

            .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
            .Font.Size = 10
            .Font.Bold = True

            .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

            .Interior.Color = RGB(56, 96, 170)

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

        End With

    Next i

    ' =========================================================
    ' DATA ROWS
    ' =========================================================

    Dim dataRow As Long
    dataRow = 4

    Dim serialNo As Integer
    serialNo = 1

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        If ws.Name = "Sheet_Index" Then GoTo skipSheet

        idx.Rows(dataRow).RowHeight = 22

        Dim bg As Long

        If serialNo Mod 2 = 0 Then
            bg = RGB(245, 247, 252)
        Else
            bg = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        End If

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' NO
        ' ----------------------------------------

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 1)

            .Value = serialNo

            .Interior.Color = bg

            .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
            .Font.Size = 10

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

        End With

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' SHEET NAME
        ' ----------------------------------------

        idx.Cells(dataRow, 2).Interior.Color = bg

        idx.Hyperlinks.Add _
            Anchor:=idx.Cells(dataRow, 2), _
            Address:="", _
            SubAddress:="'" & ws.Name & "'!A1", _
            TextToDisplay:=ws.Name

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 2)

            .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
            .Font.Size = 10

            .Font.Color = RGB(0, 70, 140)

        End With

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' USED RANGE
        ' ----------------------------------------

        Dim totalRows As Long
        Dim totalCols As Long

        On Error Resume Next

        totalRows = ws.UsedRange.Rows.count
        totalCols = ws.UsedRange.Columns.count

        On Error GoTo 0

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 3)

            .Value = totalRows

            .Interior.Color = bg

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

        End With

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 4)

            .Value = totalCols

            .Interior.Color = bg

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

        End With

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' PROTECTION
        ' ----------------------------------------

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 5)

       .Interior.Color = bg
       .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

         If ws.ProtectContents Then

        .Value = "Protected"
        .Font.Color = RGB(190, 0, 0)

    Else

        .Value = "Unprotected"
        .Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)

    End If

End With

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' VISIBILITY
        ' ----------------------------------------

        With idx.Cells(dataRow, 6)

            .Interior.Color = bg

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

            If ws.Visible = xlSheetVisible Then

                .Value = "Visible"
                .Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)

            Else

                .Value = "Hidden"
                .Font.Color = RGB(190, 0, 0)

            End If

        End With

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' ACTION BG
        ' ----------------------------------------

        idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Interior.Color = bg

        ' hidden sheet name
        idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Value = ws.Name
        idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Font.Color = bg

        ' ----------------------------------------
        ' DELETE BUTTON
        ' ----------------------------------------

        Dim delBtn As Object

        Set delBtn = idx.Buttons.Add( _
            idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).left + 2, _
            idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Top + 1, _
            idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Width - 4, _
            idx.Cells(dataRow, 7).Height - 2)

        With delBtn

            .Caption = "Delete"

            .Name = "DelBtn_" & serialNo

            .Font.Size = 9
            .Font.Bold = True

            .OnAction = "DeleteSheetFromIndex"

        End With

        dataRow = dataRow + 1
        serialNo = serialNo + 1

skipSheet:
    Next ws

    ' =========================================================
    ' COLUMN WIDTH
    ' =========================================================

    idx.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
    idx.Columns(2).ColumnWidth = 30
    idx.Columns(3).ColumnWidth = 13
    idx.Columns(4).ColumnWidth = 13
    idx.Columns(5).ColumnWidth = 16
    idx.Columns(6).ColumnWidth = 14
    idx.Columns(7).ColumnWidth = 12

    ' =========================================================
    ' BORDER
    ' =========================================================

    With idx.Range( _
        idx.Cells(3, 1), _
        idx.Cells(dataRow - 1, 7))

        .Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous

        .Borders.Color = RGB(210, 220, 235)

        .Borders.Weight = xlThin

    End With

    idx.Activate

    idx.Range("A4").Select

    ActiveWindow.DisplayGridlines = False

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Sheet Index created successfully!", vbInformation

End Sub
' ============================================================
' GENERATE SHEET GALLERY
' ============================================================
Public Sub GenerateSheetGallery(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Sheets("Sheet_Gallery").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    Dim gal As Worksheet
    Set gal = wb.Sheets.Add(Before:=wb.Sheets(1))

    gal.Name = "Sheet_Gallery"

    Dim c As Integer

    gal.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 2

    For c = 2 To 100
        gal.Columns(c).ColumnWidth = 5.5
    Next c

    gal.Rows(1).RowHeight = 10
    gal.Rows(2).RowHeight = 40
    gal.Rows(3).RowHeight = 18
    gal.Rows(4).RowHeight = 8

    ' =====================================================
    ' HEADER
    ' =====================================================

    With gal.Range("B2:AO2")

        .Merge
        .Value = "WORKBOOK SHEET GALLERY"

        .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
        .Font.Size = 18
        .Font.Bold = True

        .Font.Color = RGB(35, 35, 35)

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

        .Interior.Color = RGB(236, 241, 255)

    End With

    With gal.Range("B3:AO3")

        .Merge
        .Value = "Click Open button to navigate any sheet"

        .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
        .Font.Size = 10
        .Font.Italic = True

        .Font.Color = RGB(120, 120, 145)

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

        .Interior.Color = RGB(236, 241, 255)

    End With

    With gal.Range("B3:AO3").Borders(xlEdgeBottom)

        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Color = RGB(190, 200, 225)
        .Weight = xlThin

    End With

    ' =====================================================
    ' CARD SETTINGS
    ' =====================================================

    Dim cardStartCols As Variant
    cardStartCols = Array(2, 16, 30)

    Const CARD_COLS As Integer = 12
    Const PREV_ROWS As Integer = 8
    Const CARD_ROWS As Integer = 12
    Const ROW_GAP As Integer = 2
    Const DATA_START As Integer = 5

    Dim cardCount As Integer
    cardCount = 0

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    For Each ws In wb.Sheets

        If ws.Name = "Sheet_Gallery" _
        Or ws.Name = "Sheet_Index" Then GoTo skipSheet

        Dim col0 As Integer
        Dim row0 As Integer
        Dim col1 As Integer

        col0 = cardStartCols(cardCount Mod 3)

        row0 = DATA_START + _
               (cardCount \ 3) * (CARD_ROWS + ROW_GAP)

        col1 = col0 + CARD_COLS - 1

        ' card bg
        With gal.Range( _
            gal.Cells(row0, col0), _
            gal.Cells(row0 + CARD_ROWS - 1, col1))

            .Interior.Color = RGB(252, 253, 255)

        End With

        ' outer border
        With gal.Range( _
            gal.Cells(row0, col0), _
            gal.Cells(row0 + CARD_ROWS - 1, col1))

            .Borders(xlEdgeLeft).LineStyle = xlContinuous
            .Borders(xlEdgeRight).LineStyle = xlContinuous
            .Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle = xlContinuous
            .Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle = xlContinuous

            .Borders(xlEdgeLeft).Weight = xlMedium
            .Borders(xlEdgeRight).Weight = xlMedium
            .Borders(xlEdgeTop).Weight = xlMedium
            .Borders(xlEdgeBottom).Weight = xlMedium

            .Borders.Color = RGB(185, 195, 225)

        End With

        ' top blue bar
        With gal.Range( _
            gal.Cells(row0, col0), _
            gal.Cells(row0 + 1, col1))

            .Merge
            .Interior.Color = RGB(92, 130, 255)

        End With

        With gal.Cells(row0, col0)

            .Value = ws.Name

            .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
            .Font.Size = 8
            .Font.Bold = True

            .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

            .HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
            .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

            .IndentLevel = 1

        End With

        ' preview
        Dim pr As Integer
        Dim pc As Integer

        For pr = 1 To PREV_ROWS

            For pc = 1 To CARD_COLS

                Dim cellVal As String
                cellVal = ""

                On Error Resume Next

                If pr <= ws.UsedRange.Rows.count _
                And pc <= ws.UsedRange.Columns.count Then

                    cellVal = left(CStr(ws.Cells(pr, pc).Value), 6)

                End If

                On Error GoTo 0

                With gal.Cells( _
                    row0 + 2 + pr - 1, _
                    col0 + pc - 1)

                    .Value = cellVal

                    .Font.Name = "Segoe UI"
                    .Font.Size = 6

                    .Font.Color = RGB(70, 70, 95)

                    If pr Mod 2 = 0 Then
                        .Interior.Color = RGB(247, 249, 255)
                    Else
                        .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    End If

                End With

            Next pc

        Next pr

        ' preview border
        With gal.Range( _
            gal.Cells(row0 + 2, col0), _
            gal.Cells(row0 + 2 + PREV_ROWS - 1, col1))

            .Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
            .Borders.Color = RGB(222, 228, 240)
            .Borders.Weight = xlThin

        End With

        ' =================================================
        ' OPEN BUTTON
        ' =================================================

        gal.Rows(row0 + CARD_ROWS - 1).RowHeight = 24

        Dim shpBtn As Shape

        Dim btnLeft As Double
        Dim btnTop As Double
        Dim btnWidth As Double
        Dim btnHt As Double

        btnLeft = gal.Cells( _
                    row0 + CARD_ROWS - 1, col0).left + 6

        btnTop = gal.Cells( _
                   row0 + CARD_ROWS - 1, col0).Top - 2

        btnWidth = gal.Cells(row0, col1).left + _
                   gal.Columns(col1).Width - _
                   gal.Cells(row0, col0).left - 12

        btnHt = 28

        Set shpBtn = gal.Shapes.AddShape( _
                        msoShapeRoundedRectangle, _
                        btnLeft, btnTop, _
                        btnWidth, btnHt)

        With shpBtn

            .Name = "btn_" & ws.Index

            .AlternativeText = ws.Name

            .Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(70, 120, 240)

            .Line.Visible = msoFalse

            .Adjustments.Item(1) = 0.25

            .Shadow.Visible = msoTrue

            .TextFrame2.TextRange.text = "Open"

            .TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Size = 10
            .TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Bold = msoTrue

            .TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = _
                RGB(255, 255, 255)

            .TextFrame2.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorMiddle

            .TextFrame2.TextRange.ParagraphFormat.Alignment = _
                msoAlignCenter

            .OnAction = "'" & ThisWorkbook.Name & "'!OpenSheetFromBtn"

        End With

        cardCount = cardCount + 1

skipSheet:
    Next ws

    gal.Activate

    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 100

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Gallery ready!", vbInformation

End Sub


' ============================================================
' OPEN SHEET
' ============================================================
Public Sub OpenSheetFromBtn()

    Dim shp As Shape

    Set shp = ActiveSheet.Shapes(Application.Caller)

    On Error Resume Next

    ActiveWorkbook.Sheets(shp.AlternativeText).Activate

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub

' ============================================================
' DELETE SHEET FROM INDEX
' ============================================================
Public Sub DeleteSheetFromIndex()

    On Error GoTo errHandle

    Dim btnName As String
    btnName = Application.Caller

    Dim btnNo As Integer
    btnNo = CInt(Replace(btnName, "DelBtn_", ""))

    Dim idx As Worksheet
    Set idx = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Sheet_Index")

    Dim r As Long
    Dim sheetName As String

    For r = 4 To idx.UsedRange.Rows.count + 3

        If idx.Cells(r, 1).Value = btnNo Then

            sheetName = idx.Cells(r, 7).Value

            Exit For

        End If

    Next r

    If sheetName = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim ask As Integer

    ask = MsgBox( _
        "Delete sheet '" & sheetName & "' ?", _
        vbYesNo + vbCritical)

    If ask = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    ActiveWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName).Delete

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    Dim dummy As IRibbonControl

    Call GenerateSheetIndex(dummy)

    Exit Sub

errHandle:

    MsgBox Err.Description, vbExclamation

End Sub
' ============================================================
' ADD BACK BUTTONS — bottom-right, uses Forms Button (no TextFrame2)
' ============================================================
Public Sub AddBackButtons(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    Dim answer As Integer
    answer = MsgBox("Back button goes to:" & vbNewLine & _
                    "Yes = Sheet_Gallery" & vbNewLine & _
                    "No  = Sheet_Index", _
                    vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "XLSmart - Back Button Target")

    Dim targetSheet As String
    If answer = vbYes Then
        targetSheet = "Sheet_Gallery"
    Else
        targetSheet = "Sheet_Index"
    End If

    ' Store target
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Names("XLS_BackTarget").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Names.Add Name:="XLS_BackTarget", _
                 RefersTo:="=""" & targetSheet & """"

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In wb.Sheets
        If ws.Name = "Sheet_Index" Or ws.Name = "Sheet_Gallery" Then GoTo SkipBack

        ' Remove old back button
        Dim shp As Shape
        For Each shp In ws.Shapes
            If shp.Name = "XLS_BackBtn" Then
                shp.Delete
                Exit For
            End If
        Next shp

        ' Also remove any Forms buttons named XLS_BackBtn
        Dim ob As Object
        For Each ob In ws.Buttons
            If ob.Name = "XLS_BackBtn" Then
                ob.Delete
                Exit For
            End If
        Next ob

        ' Find bottom-right position
        Dim lastR As Long, lastC As Long
        On Error Resume Next
        lastR = ws.UsedRange.Rows(ws.UsedRange.Rows.count).Row
        lastC = ws.UsedRange.Columns(ws.UsedRange.Columns.count).Column
        On Error GoTo 0
        If lastR < 1 Then lastR = 1
        If lastC < 1 Then lastC = 1

        ' Button dimensions
        Dim btnL As Double, btnT As Double
        Dim btnW As Double, btnH As Double
        btnW = 110
        btnH = 22

        ' Position: top-left (A1)
        btnL = ws.Cells(1, 1).left + 5
        btnT = ws.Cells(1, 1).Top + 5

        ' Use Forms Button   works on ALL Excel versions, no TextFrame2 needed
        Dim Btn As Object
        Set Btn = ws.Buttons.Add(btnL, btnT, btnW, btnH)
        Btn.Name = "XLS_BackBtn"
        Btn.Caption = "<< Back to Home"
        Btn.Font.Size = 9
        Btn.Font.Bold = True
        Btn.OnAction = "GoBackHome"

SkipBack:
    Next ws

    MsgBox "Back to Home buttons added to all sheets!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
End Sub

' ============================================================
' GO BACK HOME
' ============================================================
Public Sub GoBackHome()
    Dim targetSheet As String
    On Error Resume Next
    targetSheet = Evaluate(ActiveWorkbook.Names("XLS_BackTarget").RefersTo)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If Trim(targetSheet) = "" Then targetSheet = "Sheet_Index"

    On Error Resume Next
    ActiveWorkbook.Sheets(targetSheet).Activate
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Home sheet not found. Please generate Sheet Index or Gallery first.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' ============================================================
' REMOVE BACK BUTTONS
' ============================================================
Public Sub RemoveBackButtons(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim ob As Object
    For Each ws In wb.Sheets
        ' Remove Forms buttons
        For Each ob In ws.Buttons
            If ob.Name = "XLS_BackBtn" Then ob.Delete
        Next ob
        ' Remove any Shape-based buttons
        Dim shp As Shape
        For Each shp In ws.Shapes
            If shp.Name = "XLS_BackBtn" Then shp.Delete
        Next shp
    Next ws

    MsgBox "All Back to Home buttons removed!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
End Sub

VBA MACRO modAITools.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modAITools'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' AI FORMULA GENERATOR
' ============================================================
Public Sub AIFormulaGenerator(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    ' Collect sheet column headers
    Dim sheetInfo As String
    sheetInfo = GetSheetHeaders(ws)

    Dim userPrompt As String
    userPrompt = InputBox( _
        "Describe what formula you need:" & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Examples:" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Sum of total sales" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Convert DOB to exact age in years months days" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - VLOOKUP customer name from Sheet2" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Count orders where state is Maharashtra" & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Sheet: " & ws.Name & vbNewLine & _
        "Columns: " & sheetInfo, _
        "XLSmart - AI Formula Generator")

    If Trim(userPrompt) = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim prompt As String
    prompt = "I have an Excel sheet named " & ws.Name & _
             " with columns: " & sheetInfo & ". " & _
             "Task: " & userPrompt & ". " & _
             "Give me only the Excel formula starting with = sign. No explanation."

    OpenChatGPT prompt
End Sub

' ============================================================
' AI FORMULA EXPLAINER
' ============================================================
Public Sub AIFormulaExplainer(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Selection.Cells.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "Please select a single cell containing a formula.", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cell As Range
    Set cell = Selection

    If left(cell.Formula, 1) <> "=" Then
        MsgBox "Selected cell does not contain a formula!" & vbNewLine & _
               "Please select a cell with a formula (starts with =).", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lang As String
    lang = InputBox("Explain formula in which language?", "XLSmart", "Hindi")
    If lang = "" Then lang = "Hindi"

    Dim prompt As String
    prompt = "Explain this Excel formula step by step in " & lang & ": " & cell.Formula & _
             ". Break down each part clearly."

    OpenChatGPT prompt
End Sub

' ============================================================
' AI FORMULA ERROR DETECTOR
' ============================================================
Public Sub AIFormulaErrorDetector(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Selection.Cells.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "Please select a single cell containing a formula error.", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cell As Range
    Set cell = Selection

    If left(cell.Formula, 1) <> "=" Then
        MsgBox "Selected cell does not contain a formula!", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim errVal As String
    errVal = CStr(cell.Value)

    Dim prompt As String
    prompt = "This Excel formula has an error. Find the exact reason and give corrected formula." & _
             " Formula: " & cell.Formula & _
             " Error shown: " & errVal & _
             ". Reply with: 1) Error reason 2) Corrected formula only."

    OpenChatGPT prompt
End Sub

' ============================================================
' AI COMMENT GENERATOR
' ============================================================
Public Sub AICommentGenerator(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Selection.Cells.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "Please select a single cell to generate comment for.", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cell As Range
    Set cell = Selection

    Dim cellValue As String
    cellValue = CStr(cell.Value)

    If cellValue = "" Then
        MsgBox "Selected cell is empty!", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim commentType As String
    commentType = InputBox( _
        "What kind of comment for cell " & cell.Address & "?" & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Value: " & cellValue & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Examples:" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Explain this value" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Add a warning note" & vbNewLine & _
        "  - Explain this formula result", _
        "XLSmart - AI Comment Generator", _
        "Explain this value in 1-2 lines")

    If Trim(commentType) = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim prompt As String
    prompt = "Excel cell " & cell.Address & " in sheet " & cell.Parent.Name & _
             " has value: " & cellValue & ". Task: " & commentType & _
             ". Write a short cell comment in max 2 lines. Be concise."

    OpenChatGPT prompt

    ' Let user paste comment manually
    Dim addNow As Integer
    addNow = MsgBox("ChatGPT opened in browser." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                    "Copy the AI response, then click Yes to paste as cell comment.", _
                    vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "XLSmart")

    If addNow = vbYes Then
        Dim commentText As String
        commentText = InputBox("Paste the comment for cell " & cell.Address & ":", "XLSmart")
        If Trim(commentText) <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            cell.Comment.Delete
            On Error GoTo 0
            cell.AddComment commentText
            cell.Comment.Shape.TextFrame.AutoSize = True
            MsgBox "Comment added to " & cell.Address, vbInformation, "XLSmart"
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' ============================================================
' HELPER: Open ChatGPT in browser with pre-filled prompt
' ============================================================
Private Sub OpenChatGPT(prompt As String)
    Dim encoded As String
    encoded = URLEncode(prompt)
    Dim url As String
    url = "https://chat.openai.com/?q=" & encoded
    Shell "cmd /c start " & Chr(34) & Chr(34) & " " & Chr(34) & url & Chr(34), vbHide
End Sub

' ============================================================
' HELPER: URL Encode
' ============================================================
Private Function URLEncode(txt As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim c As String
    For i = 1 To Len(txt)
        c = Mid(txt, i, 1)
        Select Case asc(c)
            Case 65 To 90, 97 To 122, 48 To 57
                result = result & c
            Case 32
                result = result & "+"
            Case Else
                result = result & "%" & right("0" & Hex(asc(c)), 2)
        End Select
    Next i
    If Len(result) > 2000 Then result = left(result, 2000)
    URLEncode = result
End Function

' ============================================================
' HELPER: Get sheet column headers as string
' ============================================================
Public Function GetSheetHeaders(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    Dim j As Integer
    On Error Resume Next
    For j = 1 To ws.UsedRange.Columns.count
        Dim h As String
        h = CStr(ws.Cells(1, j).Value)
        If h <> "" Then
            result = result & h & " (Col " & j & "), "
        End If
    Next j
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Len(result) > 2 Then result = left(result, Len(result) - 2)
    GetSheetHeaders = result
End Function

Public Sub IncreaseColourHelper()
    Dim c As Range
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, b As Long
    Dim clr As Long
    For Each c In Selection.Cells
        If c.Interior.ColorIndex <> xlNone Then
            clr = c.Interior.Color
            b = (clr \ 65536) And 255
            g = (clr \ 256) And 255
            r = clr And 255
            r = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(r + 30, 255)
            g = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(g + 30, 255)
            b = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(b + 30, 255)
            c.Interior.Color = RGB(r, g, b)
        End If
    Next c
End Sub

Public Sub DecreaseColourHelper()
    Dim c As Range
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, b As Long
    Dim clr As Long
    For Each c In Selection.Cells
        If c.Interior.ColorIndex <> xlNone Then
            clr = c.Interior.Color
            b = (clr \ 65536) And 255
            g = (clr \ 256) And 255
            r = clr And 255
            r = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(r - 30, 0)
            g = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(g - 30, 0)
            b = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(b - 30, 0)
            c.Interior.Color = RGB(r, g, b)
        End If
    Next c
End Sub

' =========================================================
' IMAGE IN COMMENT
' =========================================================

Public Sub DataUtilities_ImageInComment(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Selection.Cells.count <> 1 Then
        MsgBox "Select one cell first."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim fPath As String

    fPath = Application.GetOpenFilename( _
    "Images (*.png;*.jpg),*.png;*.jpg")

    If fPath = "False" Then Exit Sub

    Dim scaleInput As String
    scaleInput = InputBox("Enter image scale %", "Image Size", "100")

    If scaleInput = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim scalePct As Double
    scalePct = val(scaleInput) / 100

    If scalePct <= 0 Then scalePct = 1

    On Error Resume Next
    Selection.Comment.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

    Dim cmt As Comment

    Set cmt = Selection.AddComment("")

    With cmt.Shape

        .Fill.UserPicture fPath
        .Width = 150 * scalePct
        .Height = 150 * scalePct

    End With

    cmt.Visible = False

    MsgBox "Image added."

End Sub

' =========================================================
' QR CODE FIXED
' =========================================================

Public Sub DataUtilities_CreateQRCode(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim sizeInput As String

    sizeInput = InputBox( _
        "Enter QR Size", _
        "QR Code", "250")

    If sizeInput = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Not IsNumeric(sizeInput) Then Exit Sub

    Dim qrSize As Long
    qrSize = CLng(sizeInput)

    Dim c As Range

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    For Each c In Selection.Cells

        If Trim(c.Value) <> "" Then

            Dim apiURL As String

            apiURL = "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=" & _
                     qrSize & "x" & qrSize & "&data=" & EncodeURL(CStr(c.Value))

            Dim pic As Picture

            On Error Resume Next
            Set pic = ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(apiURL)
            On Error GoTo 0

            If Not pic Is Nothing Then

                With pic
                    .left = c.left
                    .Top = c.Offset(1, 0).Top
                    .Width = 90
                    .Height = 90
                End With

            End If

        End If

    Next c

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "QR Code generated."

End Sub

Public Sub DataUtilities_ClearQRCodes(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim shp As Shape

    For Each shp In ActiveSheet.Shapes

        If shp.Type = msoPicture Then

            If left(shp.Name, 3) = "Pic" Then
                shp.Delete
            End If

        End If

    Next shp

End Sub

Private Function EncodeURL(txt As String) As String

    Dim i As Long
    Dim result As String
    Dim ch As String

    Dim safe As String
    safe = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_.~"

    For i = 1 To Len(txt)

        ch = Mid(txt, i, 1)

        If InStr(safe, ch) > 0 Then
            result = result & ch
        Else
            result = result & "%" & Hex(asc(ch))
        End If

    Next i

    EncodeURL = result

End Function

' =========================================================
' BARCODE - MODERN IMAGE STYLE
' Popup Size + Real Barcode Look
' =========================================================

Public Sub DataUtilities_CreateBarCode(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Selection.Cells.count = 0 Then Exit Sub

    ' -----------------------------------------
    ' Size Popup
    ' -----------------------------------------
    
    Dim sizeInput As String

    sizeInput = InputBox( _
        "Enter desired barcode width in pixels:" & vbLf & _
        "Standard: 250 | High: 350 | Ultra: 500", _
        "Bar Code Size", "350")

    If sizeInput = "" Then Exit Sub

    If Not IsNumeric(sizeInput) Then
        MsgBox "Please enter a valid size.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim barSize As Long
    barSize = CLng(sizeInput)

    If barSize < 150 Then barSize = 150
    If barSize > 1000 Then barSize = 1000

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim c As Range

    For Each c In Selection.Cells

        If Trim(CStr(c.Value)) <> "" Then

            Dim barcodeURL As String

            ' online barcode api
            barcodeURL = "https://barcode.tec-it.com/barcode.ashx?data=" & _
             EncodeURL(CStr(c.Value)) & _
             "&code=Code128&dpi=96&translate-esc=on&hidehrt=True"

            Dim pic As Picture

            On Error Resume Next
            Set pic = ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(barcodeURL)
            On Error GoTo 0

            If Not pic Is Nothing Then

                With pic

                    .left = c.Offset(0, 2).left
                    .Top = c.Top

                    ' modern wide barcode look
                    .Width = barSize
                    .Height = barSize * 0.28

                End With

            End If

        End If

    Next c

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Barcode generated successfully.", vbInformation

End Sub

' =========================================================
' TRIM TEXT (ADVANCED)
' Removes:
' 1. Start/End extra spaces
' 2. Multiple spaces inside text
' 3. Hidden non-breaking spaces
' =========================================================

Public Sub DataUtilities_TrimText(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim c As Range
    Dim txt As String

    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    For Each c In Selection.Cells

        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then

            txt = CStr(c.Value)

            ' remove hidden spaces
            txt = Replace(txt, Chr(160), " ")

            ' clean unwanted characters
            txt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Clean(txt)

            ' proper trim
            txt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Trim(txt)

            c.Value = txt

        End If

    Next c

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Trim complete.", vbInformation

End Sub

' =========================================================
' FOCUS CELL - SAFE VERSION
' Existing formatting remove hobe na
' =========================================================

Public Sub Visual_FocusCell(control As IRibbonControl)

    If focusIsOn Then

        FocusCell_Clear
        focusIsOn = False

        MsgBox "Focus Cell OFF", vbInformation

    Else

        focusColor = RGB(255, 255, 153)
        focusIsOn = True

        Call ThisWorkbook.ActivateAppEvent

        PaintFocusCell

        MsgBox "Focus Cell ON", vbInformation

    End If

End Sub
' =========================================================
' PAINT FOCUS CELL - PREMIUM VERSION
' =========================================================
Public Sub PaintFocusCell()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim usedRng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long

    If Not focusIsOn Then Exit Sub
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub

    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    On Error Resume Next

    lastRow = ws.Cells.Find("*", SearchOrder:=xlByRows, SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Row
    lastCol = ws.Cells.Find("*", SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Column

    If lastRow = 0 Or lastCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Set usedRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    ' clear previous focus
    FocusCell_Clear

    ' current row + column
    Set prevRow = Intersect(ws.Rows(ActiveCell.Row), usedRng)
    Set prevCol = Intersect(ws.Columns(ActiveCell.Column), usedRng)

    ' ---------- ROW ----------
    If Not prevRow Is Nothing Then

        ReDim prevRowColors(1 To prevRow.Cells.count)

        For i = 1 To prevRow.Cells.count

            prevRowColors(i) = prevRow.Cells(i).DisplayFormat.Interior.Color

            ' header skip
            If prevRow.Cells(i).Row > 1 Then
                prevRow.Cells(i).Interior.Color = focusColor
            End If

        Next i

    End If

    ' ---------- COLUMN ----------
    If Not prevCol Is Nothing Then

        ReDim prevColColors(1 To prevCol.Cells.count)

        For i = 1 To prevCol.Cells.count

            prevColColors(i) = prevCol.Cells(i).DisplayFormat.Interior.Color

            ' skip header + avoid intersection overwrite
            If prevCol.Cells(i).Row > 1 _
            And prevCol.Cells(i).Row <> ActiveCell.Row Then

                prevCol.Cells(i).Interior.Color = focusColor

            End If

        Next i

    End If

    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub


' =========================================================
' CLEAR FOCUS CELL - FIX PREVIOUS COLOR STUCK
' =========================================================
' =========================================================
' CLEAR FOCUS CELL
' =========================================================
Public Sub FocusCell_Clear()

    Dim i As Long
    Dim c As Range

    On Error Resume Next

    ' restore row
    If Not prevRow Is Nothing Then

        For i = 1 To prevRow.Cells.count
            prevRow.Cells(i).Interior.Color = prevRowColors(i)
        Next i

    End If

    ' restore column
    If Not prevCol Is Nothing Then

        For i = 1 To prevCol.Cells.count

            Set c = prevCol.Cells(i)

            If prevRow Is Nothing Then
                c.Interior.Color = prevColColors(i)
            Else
                If Intersect(c, prevRow) Is Nothing Then
                    c.Interior.Color = prevColColors(i)
                End If
            End If

        Next i

    End If

    Set prevRow = Nothing
    Set prevCol = Nothing

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


' =========================================================
' COLOR CHANGE
' =========================================================
Public Sub Visual_FocusCellColor(control As IRibbonControl)

    If Not focusIsOn Then Exit Sub

    focusColor = RGB(Int(Rnd * 255), _
                     Int(Rnd * 255), _
                     Int(Rnd * 255))

    PaintFocusCell

    MsgBox "Focus color changed.", vbInformation

End Sub

    If focusIsOn Then

    End If

' ----- Block Duplicates -----
Public Sub ValidationTools_BlockDuplicates(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim rng As Range
    Set rng = GetSelectedRange()
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    With rng.Validation
        .Delete
        .Add Type:=xlValidateCustom, _
             AlertStyle:=xlValidAlertStop, _
             Formula1:="=COUNTIF(" & rng.Columns(1).Address & "," & rng.Columns(1).Cells(1).Address(False, False) & ")=1"
        .IgnoreBlank = True
        .ShowInput = False
        .ShowError = True
        .ErrorTitle = "Duplicate Entry"
        .ErrorMessage = "Duplicate entries are not allowed in this column!"
    End With
    MsgBox "Block Duplicates validation applied successfully!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "XLSmart"
End Sub

' ----- Gmail Validation -----
Public Sub ValidationTools_Email(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim firstCell As String

    Set rng = GetSelectedRange()
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    firstCell = rng.Cells(1, 1).Address(False, False)

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    rng.Validation.Delete

    rng.Validation.Add _
        Type:=xlValidateCustom, _
        AlertStyle:=xlValidAlertStop, _
        Formula1:="=RIGHT(LOWER(" & firstCell & "),10)=""@gmail.com"""

    With rng.Validation
        .IgnoreBlank = True
        .ShowError = True
        .ErrorTitle = "Invalid Gmail"
        .ErrorMessage = "Only Gmail addresses are allowed"
    End With

    MsgBox "Email validation added successfully.", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Bangladesh Phone Validation -----
Public Sub ValidationTools_Phone(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim firstCell As String

    Set rng = GetSelectedRange()
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    firstCell = rng.Cells(1, 1).Address(False, False)

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' keep leading zero
    rng.NumberFormat = "@"

    rng.Validation.Delete

    rng.Validation.Add _
        Type:=xlValidateCustom, _
        AlertStyle:=xlValidAlertStop, _
        Formula1:="=AND(LEN(" & firstCell & "&"""")=11,LEFT(" & firstCell & ",2)=""01"")"

    With rng.Validation
        .IgnoreBlank = True
        .ShowError = True
        .ErrorTitle = "Invalid Phone Number"
        .ErrorMessage = "Enter a valid Bangladesh mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX)"
    End With

    MsgBox "Bangladesh phone validation applied successfully!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ============================================================
' HELPER: Get Selected Range (with guard)
' ============================================================
Private Function GetSelectedRange() As Range
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "Please select a cell range first!", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Set GetSelectedRange = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    Set GetSelectedRange = Selection
End Function

' ----- UPPERCASE -----
Public Sub SheetManager_Uppercase(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim cell As Range
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "Please select a range first!", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For Each cell In Selection
        If Not cell.HasFormula Then
            If Trim(cell.Value) <> "" Then
                cell.Value = UCase(cell.Value)
            End If
        End If
    Next cell
    MsgBox "Text converted to UPPERCASE successfully!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
End Sub

' ----- Import Sheets -----
Public Sub SheetManager_ImportSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim fd As FileDialog

    Dim srcWB As Workbook
    Dim destWB As Workbook

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim copiedWs As Worksheet

    Dim filePath As String
    Dim newName As String

    Dim okCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim logText As String

    Dim hasHidden As Boolean
    Dim importHidden As VbMsgBoxResult

    Dim oldState As XlSheetVisibility


    Set destWB = ActiveWorkbook

    If destWB Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)

    With fd

        .Title = "Select Source Workbook"

        .Filters.Clear
        .Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls; *.xlsb"

        .AllowMultiSelect = False

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        filePath = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With


    On Error GoTo MainErr

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    Set srcWB = Workbooks.Open(filePath, ReadOnly:=True)


    ' workbook structure protection
    If srcWB.ProtectStructure Then

        MsgBox "Source workbook structure is protected." & vbCrLf & _
               "Please unprotect workbook first.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        GoTo SafeExit

    End If


    ' check hidden sheets
    For Each ws In srcWB.Worksheets

        If ws.Visible <> xlSheetVisible Then

            hasHidden = True
            Exit For

        End If

    Next ws


    ' ask user
    If hasHidden Then

        importHidden = MsgBox( _
            "This workbook contains hidden sheets." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "YES  = Import all sheets including hidden sheets" & vbCrLf & _
            "NO   = Skip hidden sheets", _
            vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
            "XLSmart - Hidden Sheets Found")

    End If



    ' import sheets
    For Each ws In srcWB.Worksheets

        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        ' skip hidden sheets if user clicked NO
        If hasHidden Then

            If importHidden = vbNo Then

                If ws.Visible <> xlSheetVisible Then

                    skipCount = skipCount + 1

                    logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                              "Skipped Hidden: " & ws.Name

                    GoTo NextSheet

                End If

            End If

        End If


        newName = ws.Name

        If SheetExists(newName, destWB) Then
            newName = MakeUniqueSheetName(newName, destWB)
        End If


        ' save original hidden state
        oldState = ws.Visible


        ' temporary visible for safe copy
        If ws.Visible <> xlSheetVisible Then
            ws.Visible = xlSheetVisible
        End If


        ' safer copy
        ws.Copy

        Set copiedWs = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets(1)

        copiedWs.Move After:=destWB.Sheets(destWB.Sheets.count)



        ' rename copied sheet
        Err.Clear

        On Error Resume Next

        copiedWs.Name = newName

        If Err.Number <> 0 Then

            copiedWs.Name = "Sheet_" & _
                            Format(Timer * 100, "0")

            Err.Clear

        End If

        On Error GoTo SheetErr



        ' restore hidden state in imported sheet
        Err.Clear

        On Error Resume Next

        copiedWs.Visible = oldState
        Err.Clear

        ws.Visible = oldState
        Err.Clear

        On Error GoTo SheetErr



        ' successful import
        okCount = okCount + 1


NextSheet:

        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0

    Next ws



    MsgBox okCount & " sheet(s) imported successfully." & _
           vbCrLf & skipCount & " skipped." & _
           vbCrLf & logText, _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    GoTo SafeExit



' per sheet error
SheetErr:

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

        skipCount = skipCount + 1

        logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                  "Failed: " & ws.Name & _
                  " | " & Err.Description

    End If

    Err.Clear
    Resume Next



MainErr:

    MsgBox "Import failed : " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"



SafeExit:

    On Error Resume Next

    If Not srcWB Is Nothing Then
        srcWB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.EnableEvents = True

End Sub




' ----- Check Existing Sheet -----
Private Function SheetExists(sName As String, wb As Workbook) As Boolean

    Dim sht As Worksheet

    For Each sht In wb.Worksheets

        If LCase(Trim(sht.Name)) = LCase(Trim(sName)) Then

            SheetExists = True
            Exit Function

        End If

    Next sht

End Function




' ----- Create Unique Sheet Name -----
Private Function MakeUniqueSheetName(baseName As String, wb As Workbook) As String

    Dim tempName As String
    Dim n As Long

    tempName = left(baseName, 25)

    n = 1

    Do While SheetExists(tempName & "_" & n, wb)

        n = n + 1

    Loop

    MakeUniqueSheetName = tempName & "_" & n

End Function

' ----- Auto-Fit Sheets -----
Public Sub SheetManager_AutoFitSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long

    Dim rng As Range

    Dim okCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim logText As String

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult
    Dim onlyActive As Boolean


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    ' ask user
    ans = MsgBox( _
        "YES = Apply Auto-Fit to Active Sheet only" & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = Apply Auto-Fit to All Sheets", _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "XLSmart - AutoFit")



    If ans = vbYes Then
        onlyActive = True
    Else
        onlyActive = False
    End If



    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    ' ----- ACTIVE SHEET ONLY -----
    If onlyActive Then

        Set ws = ActiveSheet

        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        If ws.ProtectContents Then

            MsgBox "Active sheet is protected.", _
                   vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

            GoTo SafeExit

        End If


        lastRow = 0
        lastCol = 0

        On Error Resume Next

        lastRow = ws.Cells.Find(What:="*", _
                    SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                    SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Row

        lastCol = ws.Cells.Find(What:="*", _
                    SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, _
                    SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Column

        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        If lastRow > 0 And lastCol > 0 Then

            Set rng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), _
                               ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))

            rng.Columns.AutoFit

            On Error Resume Next
            rng.Rows.AutoFit
            Err.Clear
            On Error GoTo SheetErr

        End If


        Application.ScreenUpdating = True

        MsgBox "Auto-Fit applied to active sheet successfully!", _
               vbInformation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If




    ' ----- ALL SHEETS -----
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        If ws.ProtectContents Then

            skipCount = skipCount + 1

            logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                      "Skipped Protected: " & ws.Name

            GoTo NextSheet

        End If


        lastRow = 0
        lastCol = 0

        On Error Resume Next

        lastRow = ws.Cells.Find(What:="*", _
                    SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                    SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Row

        lastCol = ws.Cells.Find(What:="*", _
                    SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, _
                    SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).Column

        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        If lastRow = 0 Or lastCol = 0 Then
            GoTo NextSheet
        End If


        Set rng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), _
                           ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))

        rng.Columns.AutoFit

        On Error Resume Next
        rng.Rows.AutoFit
        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo SheetErr


        okCount = okCount + 1


NextSheet:

        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0

    Next ws


    Application.ScreenUpdating = True


    MsgBox "Auto-Fit applied successfully!" & _
           vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Success : " & okCount & vbCrLf & _
           "Skipped : " & skipCount & _
           vbCrLf & logText, _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



SheetErr:

    skipCount = skipCount + 1

    logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
              "Failed: " & ws.Name & _
              " | " & Err.Description

    Err.Clear
    Resume Next



SafeExit:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

' ----- Hide Sheets -----
Public Sub SheetManager_HideSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim activeWS As Worksheet

    Dim hideCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim logText As String
    Dim finalMsg As String


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    Set activeWS = ActiveSheet


    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False


    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        If ws.Name <> activeWS.Name Then

            On Error Resume Next

            ws.Visible = xlSheetHidden

            If Err.Number = 0 Then

                hideCount = hideCount + 1

            Else

                skipCount = skipCount + 1

                logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                          "Failed: " & ws.Name

                Err.Clear

            End If

            On Error GoTo ErrHandler

        End If

    Next ws


    Application.ScreenUpdating = True


    finalMsg = hideCount & " sheet(s) hidden successfully!" & _
               vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               "Active Sheet : " & activeWS.Name


    If skipCount > 0 Then

        finalMsg = finalMsg & _
                   vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                   "Skipped : " & skipCount & _
                   vbCrLf & logText

    End If


    MsgBox finalMsg, vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub


ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Select / Unselect Shapes -----
Public Sub SheetManager_SelectShapes(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim shp As Shape

    Dim count As Long

    Static shapesSelected As Boolean


    Set ws = ActiveSheet


    On Error GoTo ErrHandler


    If ws.Shapes.count = 0 Then

        MsgBox "No shapes found on the current sheet!", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' ----- UNSELECT -----
    If shapesSelected = True Then

        ws.Range("A1").Select

        shapesSelected = False

        MsgBox "Shapes unselected successfully!", _
               vbInformation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' ----- SELECT -----
    For Each shp In ws.Shapes
        count = count + 1
    Next shp


    ws.Shapes.SelectAll

    shapesSelected = True


    MsgBox count & " shape(s) selected!", _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Values to Text Format -----
Public Sub SheetManager_ValuesToText(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim cell As Range
    
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "Please select a range first!", vbExclamation, "XLSmart"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    For Each cell In Selection
        If Not cell.HasFormula Then
            Dim val As String
            val = CStr(cell.Value)
            cell.NumberFormat = "@"
            cell.Value = val
        End If
    Next cell
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Values converted to Text format successfully!", vbInformation, "XLSmart"
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "XLSmart"
End Sub

' ----- Duplicate Active Sheet -----
Public Sub SheetManager_DuplicateSheet(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim srcSheet As Worksheet
    Dim newSheet As Worksheet

    Dim baseName As String
    Dim tryName As String

    Dim n As Long
    Dim existsOk As Boolean

    Dim ws As Worksheet


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    Set srcSheet = ActiveSheet


    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False


    ' duplicate sheet
    srcSheet.Copy After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.count)

    Set newSheet = wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.count)



    ' name style -> SheetName (1)
    baseName = srcSheet.Name

    n = 1

CheckAgain:

    tryName = baseName & " (" & n & ")"

    existsOk = False


    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        If ws.Name = tryName And ws.Index <> newSheet.Index Then

            existsOk = True
            Exit For

        End If

    Next ws


    If existsOk = True Then

        n = n + 1
        GoTo CheckAgain

    End If


    newSheet.Name = tryName


    Application.ScreenUpdating = True


    MsgBox "Sheet duplicated successfully!" & _
           vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "New Sheet : " & newSheet.Name, _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Sort Sheets A-Z -----
Public Sub SheetManager_SortAZ(control As IRibbonControl)

    SortSheets True

End Sub




' ----- Sort Sheets Z-A -----
Public Sub SheetManager_SortZA(control As IRibbonControl)

    SortSheets False

End Sub




' ----- Main Sort Function -----
Private Sub SortSheets(isAZ As Boolean)

    Dim wb As Workbook

    Dim i As Long
    Dim j As Long

    Dim moved As Boolean

    Dim msgText As String


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False


    ' bubble sort style
    Do

        moved = False

        For i = 1 To wb.Worksheets.count - 1

            If isAZ = True Then

                If UCase(wb.Worksheets(i).Name) > _
                   UCase(wb.Worksheets(i + 1).Name) Then

                    wb.Worksheets(i + 1).Move _
                    Before:=wb.Worksheets(i)

                    moved = True

                End If

            Else

                If UCase(wb.Worksheets(i).Name) < _
                   UCase(wb.Worksheets(i + 1).Name) Then

                    wb.Worksheets(i + 1).Move _
                    Before:=wb.Worksheets(i)

                    moved = True

                End If

            End If

        Next i

    Loop While moved = True


    Application.ScreenUpdating = True


    If isAZ = True Then

        msgText = "Sheets sorted A-Z successfully!"

    Else

        msgText = "Sheets sorted Z-A successfully!"

    End If


    MsgBox msgText, vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Create Monthly Sheets -----
Public Sub SheetManager_MonthlySheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim s As Worksheet

    Dim i As Long

    Dim fullMonths As Variant
    Dim shortMonths As Variant

    Dim shName As String

    Dim existsOk As Boolean

    Dim createdCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    Dim yearTxt As String

    Dim finalMsg As String
    Dim logText As String


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    ' month arrays
    fullMonths = Array( _
        "January", "February", "March", "April", _
        "May", "June", "July", "August", _
        "September", "October", "November", "December")

    shortMonths = Array( _
        "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", _
        "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", _
        "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")



    ' ask user
    ans = MsgBox( _
        "YES = Create full month sheets" & vbCrLf & _
        "Example : January, February" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = Create short month with current year" & vbCrLf & _
        "Example : Jan-" & Format(Date, "yy"), _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "XLSmart - Monthly Sheets")



    yearTxt = Format(Date, "yy")


    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    For i = 0 To 11

        ' YES = January
        If ans = vbYes Then

            shName = fullMonths(i)

        Else

            ' NO = Jan-26
            shName = shortMonths(i) & "-" & yearTxt

        End If



        ' check existing sheet
        existsOk = False

        For Each s In wb.Worksheets

            If LCase(Trim(s.Name)) = _
               LCase(Trim(shName)) Then

                existsOk = True
                Exit For

            End If

        Next s



        ' create sheet
        If existsOk = False Then

            Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add( _
                     After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.count))

            ws.Name = shName

            createdCount = createdCount + 1

        Else

            skipCount = skipCount + 1

            logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                      "Already Exists: " & shName

        End If

    Next i



    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    finalMsg = createdCount & _
               " monthly sheet(s) created successfully!"


    If skipCount > 0 Then

        finalMsg = finalMsg & _
                   vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                   "Skipped : " & skipCount & _
                   vbCrLf & logText

    End If


    MsgBox finalMsg, vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error creating monthly sheets: " & _
           Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Remove Blank Sheets -----
Public Sub SheetManager_RemoveBlankSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim wsNames() As String

    Dim delCount As Long
    Dim removedCount As Long

    Dim k As Long

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    Dim finalMsg As String


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ans = MsgBox( _
        "This will permanently delete all blank sheets" & vbCrLf & _
        "from the active workbook." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Continue?", _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "XLSmart - Remove Blank Sheets")


    If ans = vbNo Then Exit Sub



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False



    ReDim wsNames(1 To wb.Worksheets.count)



    ' collect blank sheet names
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        ' keep at least 1 sheet
        If wb.Worksheets.count - removedCount <= 1 Then
            Exit For
        End If


        If WorksheetFunction.CountA(ws.Cells) = 0 Then

            delCount = delCount + 1

            wsNames(delCount) = ws.Name

        End If

    Next ws




    ' delete sheets
    For k = 1 To delCount

        On Error Resume Next

        wb.Worksheets(wsNames(k)).Delete

        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            removedCount = removedCount + 1
        End If

        Err.Clear

        On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Next k



    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    If removedCount = 0 Then

        MsgBox "No blank sheets found.", _
               vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Else

        finalMsg = removedCount & _
                   " blank sheet(s) removed successfully!"

        MsgBox finalMsg, _
               vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    End If


    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Backup File -----
Public Sub Protection_BackupFile(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook

    Dim fd As FileDialog

    Dim defaultName As String
    Dim backupName As String

    Dim savePath As String

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    Dim fileExt As String
    Dim baseName As String

    Dim timestamp As String


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' workbook must be saved first
    If wb.Path = "" Then

        MsgBox "Please save the workbook first before creating a backup!", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' create dynamic backup name
    timestamp = Format(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd_hh-nn-ss")

    baseName = left(wb.Name, InStrRev(wb.Name, ".") - 1)

    fileExt = Mid(wb.Name, InStrRev(wb.Name, "."))

    backupName = baseName & "_Backup_" & timestamp & fileExt



    ' custom popup
    ans = MsgBox( _
        "BACKUP WORKBOOK BEFORE PROTECTION" & vbCrLf & _
        "===================================" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "It is recommended to create a backup." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "New Name: " & backupName & vbCrLf & _
        "Do you want to create a backup now?", _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "Create Backup?")


    If ans = vbNo Then Exit Sub



    ' save dialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)

    With fd

        .Title = "Save Backup File"

        .InitialFileName = wb.Path & "\" & backupName

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        savePath = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler


    Application.ScreenUpdating = False


    ' create backup copy
    wb.SaveCopyAs savePath


    Application.ScreenUpdating = True


    MsgBox "Backup saved successfully!" & _
           vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           savePath, _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error creating backup: " & _
           Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Protect Workbook Sheets -----
Public Sub Protection_ProtectSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim passWord As String

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    Dim protectedCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim logText As String
    Dim finalMsg As String

    Dim isStrict As Boolean


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' password input
    passWord = InputBox( _
        "Enter protection password", _
        "XLSmart - Sheet Protection")


    If Trim(passWord) = "" Then Exit Sub



    ' protection level popup
    ans = MsgBox( _
        "Select protection level" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "YES = Strict Protection" & vbCrLf & _
        "(no editing of protected cells)" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = Flexible Protection" & vbCrLf & _
        "(allow formatting)", _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "Protection Level")



    If ans = vbYes Then

        isStrict = True

    Else

        isStrict = False

    End If



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    ' apply protection to all sheets
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        On Error Resume Next


        ws.Unprotect passWord


        If isStrict = True Then

            ' strict protection
            ws.Protect passWord:=passWord, _
                       DrawingObjects:=True, _
                       Contents:=True, _
                       Scenarios:=True

        Else

            ' flexible protection
            ws.Protect passWord:=passWord, _
                       DrawingObjects:=True, _
                       Contents:=True, _
                       Scenarios:=True, _
                       AllowFormattingCells:=True, _
                       AllowFormattingColumns:=True, _
                       AllowFormattingRows:=True

        End If



        If Err.Number = 0 Then

            protectedCount = protectedCount + 1

        Else

            skipCount = skipCount + 1

            logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                      "Failed: " & ws.Name

            Err.Clear

        End If


        On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Next ws



    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    finalMsg = protectedCount & _
               " sheet(s) protected successfully!"


    If skipCount > 0 Then

        finalMsg = finalMsg & _
                   vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                   "Skipped : " & skipCount & _
                   vbCrLf & logText

    End If


    MsgBox finalMsg, vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Unprotect All Sheets -----
Public Sub Protection_UnprotectSheets(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim pwd As String

    Dim unprotectCount As Long
    Dim skipCount As Long

    Dim logText As String
    Dim finalMsg As String

    Dim wasProtected As Boolean


    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook

    If wb Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' password input
    pwd = InputBox( _
        "Enter password to unprotect all sheets:", _
        "XLSmart - Unprotect Sheets")


    If Trim(pwd) = "" Then

        MsgBox "Unprotect cancelled.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    ' unprotect all sheets
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets

        wasProtected = ws.ProtectContents Or _
                       ws.ProtectDrawingObjects Or _
                       ws.ProtectScenarios


        If wasProtected Then

            On Error Resume Next

            ws.Unprotect passWord:=pwd


            If ws.ProtectContents = False Then

                unprotectCount = unprotectCount + 1

            Else

                skipCount = skipCount + 1

                logText = logText & vbCrLf & _
                          "Wrong Password: " & ws.Name

            End If


            Err.Clear

            On Error GoTo ErrHandler

        End If

    Next ws



    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    If unprotectCount = 0 Then

        MsgBox "Incorrect password or no protected sheets found!", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

    Else

        finalMsg = unprotectCount & _
                   " sheet(s) unprotected successfully!"


        If skipCount > 0 Then

            finalMsg = finalMsg & _
                       vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                       "Skipped : " & skipCount & _
                       vbCrLf & logText

        End If


        MsgBox finalMsg, _
               vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    End If


    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error unprotecting sheets: " & _
           Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub

' ----- Lock Formulas -----
Public Sub Protection_LockFormulas(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim pwd As String
    Dim confirmPwd As String
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    pwd = InputBox("Enter password to lock all formula cells:", "XLBooster - Lock Formulas")
    If pwd = "" Then
        MsgBox "Lock cancelled. No password entered.", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If Len(pwd) < 4 Then
        MsgBox "Password must be at least 4 characters!", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    confirmPwd = InputBox("Re-enter password to confirm:", "XLBooster - Confirm Password")
    If pwd <> confirmPwd Then
        MsgBox "Passwords do not match! Lock cancelled.", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    ' Unprotect if already protected
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Unprotect passWord:=pwd
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    ' Unlock all cells first
    ws.Cells.Locked = False
    
    ' Lock only formula cells
    Dim formulaRange As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    Set formulaRange = ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeFormulas)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    If formulaRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "No formula cells found on this sheet!", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    formulaRange.Locked = True
    ws.Protect passWord:=pwd, DrawingObjects:=True, Contents:=True, Scenarios:=True
    
    MsgBox "All formula cells locked successfully!" & vbNewLine & _
           "Data cells can still be edited.", vbInformation, "XLBooster"
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Error locking formulas: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "XLBooster"
End Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim pwd As String

    pwd = InputBox("Enter password to unlock formula cells:", "XLBooster - Unlock Formulas")
    If pwd = "" Then
        MsgBox "Unlock cancelled.", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    ws.Unprotect passWord:=pwd
    ws.Cells.Locked = False
    MsgBox "Formula cells unlocked successfully!", vbInformation, "XLBooster"
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "Incorrect password or sheet is not protected!", vbExclamation, "XLBooster"
End Sub

' ----- Lock Selection -----
Public Sub Protection_LockSelection(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim pwd As String
    Dim confirmPwd As String

    Dim lockedCount As Double

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult


    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then

        MsgBox "Please select a range first!", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    lockedCount = Selection.CountLarge



    ' large selection warning
    If lockedCount > 5000 Then

        ans = MsgBox( _
            "You have selected a very large range." & vbCrLf & _
            "This may take some time." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Continue?", _
            vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
            "Large Selection")

        If ans = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    End If



    ' password input
    pwd = InputBox( _
        "Enter password to lock selected " & _
        Format(lockedCount, "#,##0") & " cell(s):", _
        "XLSmart - Lock Selection")


    If Trim(pwd) = "" Then

        MsgBox "Lock cancelled. No password entered.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' minimum password length
    If Len(pwd) < 4 Then

        MsgBox "Password must be at least 4 characters!", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    ' confirm password
    confirmPwd = InputBox( _
        "Re-enter password to confirm:", _
        "XLSmart - Confirm Password")


    If pwd <> confirmPwd Then

        MsgBox "Passwords do not match!" & vbCrLf & _
               "Lock cancelled.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    ' unprotect first
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Unprotect passWord:=pwd
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler



    ' unlock all cells
    ws.Cells.Locked = False


    ' lock only selection
    Selection.Locked = True



    ' protect sheet
    ws.Protect passWord:=pwd, _
               DrawingObjects:=True, _
               Contents:=True, _
               Scenarios:=True



    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    MsgBox Format(lockedCount, "#,##0") & _
           " cell(s) locked successfully!" & _
           vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Other cells can still be edited.", _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Error locking selection: " & _
           Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, "XLSmart"

End Sub
