    ' password input
    pwd = InputBox( _
        "Enter password to unlock selected cells:", _
        "XLSmart - Unlock Selection")


    If Trim(pwd) = "" Then

        MsgBox "Unlock cancelled.", _
               vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If



    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False



    ' unprotect sheet
    ws.Unprotect passWord:=pwd



    ' unlock selected cells
    Selection.Locked = False



    ' reprotect sheet
    ws.Protect passWord:=pwd, _
               DrawingObjects:=True, _
               Contents:=True, _
               Scenarios:=True



    Application.ScreenUpdating = True



    MsgBox Format(unlockCount, "#,##0") & _
           " cell(s) unlocked successfully!", _
           vbInformation, "XLSmart"

    Exit Sub



ErrHandler:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Incorrect password or sheet is not protected!", _
           vbExclamation, "XLSmart"

End Sub

'==============================================================================

Option Explicit

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 1. EXTRACT TEXT ONLY
' Usage: =XL_ExtractText(A1)
' Example: "SKU: 998-X (Wireless Mouse)" -> "SKU X Wireless Mouse"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ExtractText(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim c As String
    
    s = CStr(cell.Value)
    result = ""
    
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        c = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If (c >= "A" And c <= "Z") Or (c >= "a" And c <= "z") Or c = " " Then
            result = result & c
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Clean up extra spaces
    Do While InStr(result, "  ") > 0
        result = Replace(result, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    
    XL_ExtractText = Trim(result)
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 2. EXTRACT NUMBERS ONLY
' Usage: =XL_ExtractNumbers(A1)
' Example: "Invoice Amount: USD 4,500" -> "4500"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ExtractNumbers(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim c As String
    
    s = CStr(cell.Value)
    result = ""
    
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        c = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If c >= "0" And c <= "9" Then
            result = result & c
        End If
    Next i
    
    If result = "" Then
        XL_ExtractNumbers = ""
    Else
        XL_ExtractNumbers = result
    End If
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 3. EXTRACT EMAILS (Multiple email support)
' Usage: =XL_ExtractEmails(A1)
' Example: "CC: manager@hr.com, director@hr.com" -> "manager@hr.com, director@hr.com"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ExtractEmails(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim words() As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim w As String
    
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    ' cell.Text use koro - value er bodole
    s = cell.text
    If s = "" Then s = CStr(cell.Value)
    
    ' Replace common separators with space
    s = Replace(s, ",", " ")
    s = Replace(s, ";", " ")
    s = Replace(s, "|", " ")
    s = Replace(s, Chr(10), " ")  ' line break handle
    
    words = Split(s, " ")
    result = ""
    
    For i = 0 To UBound(words)
        w = Trim(words(i))
        If Len(w) < 5 Then GoTo NextWord  ' too short to be email
        
        Dim atPos As Integer
        atPos = InStr(w, "@")
        
        If atPos > 1 Then  ' @ must not be first char
            Dim dotPos As Integer
            dotPos = InStr(atPos, w, ".")
            If dotPos > atPos + 1 And dotPos < Len(w) Then  ' dot must be after @ and not last
                ' Clean trailing punctuation
                Do While Len(w) > 0
                    Dim lastChar As String
                    lastChar = right(w, 1)
                    If lastChar = "." Or lastChar = "," Or lastChar = "!" Or _
                       lastChar = ")" Or lastChar = ">" Then
                        w = left(w, Len(w) - 1)
                    Else
                        Exit Do
                    End If
                Loop
                
                If result = "" Then
                    result = w
                Else
                    result = result & ", " & w
                End If
            End If
        End If
        
NextWord:
    Next i
    
    If result = "" Then
        XL_ExtractEmails = "No email found"
    Else
        XL_ExtractEmails = result
    End If
    Exit Function
    
ErrHandler:
    XL_ExtractEmails = "Error: " & Err.Description
End Function
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 4. INDIAN MOBILE NUMBERS (10 digit)
' Usage: =XL_MobileNumberOnly(A1)
' Example: "Call me at +91-9899001122 urgent." -> "9899001122"
' Rules: 10 digit number starting with 6,7,8,9
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_MobileNumberOnly(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim digits As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim c As String

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    s = cell.text
    If s = "" Then s = CStr(cell.Value)

    ' +880 / +88 strip, 0 rekhe dao
    s = Replace(s, "+880", "0")
    s = Replace(s, "880-", "0")
    s = Replace(s, "+88", "0")
    s = Replace(s, "88-", "0")

    result = ""
    digits = ""

    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        c = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If c >= "0" And c <= "9" Then
            digits = digits & c
        Else
            result = CheckBD(digits, result)
            digits = ""
        End If
    Next i
    result = CheckBD(digits, result)

    If result = "" Then
        XL_MobileNumberOnly = "No valid number"
    Else
        XL_MobileNumberOnly = result
    End If
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    XL_MobileNumberOnly = "Error: " & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function CheckBD(digits As String, existing As String) As String
    Dim matched As String
    matched = ""

    ' BANGLADESH ONLY: 11 digit, 013~019 diye shuru
    If Len(digits) = 11 Then
        Dim prefix3 As String
        prefix3 = left(digits, 3)
        If prefix3 = "013" Or prefix3 = "014" Or prefix3 = "015" Or _
           prefix3 = "016" Or prefix3 = "017" Or prefix3 = "018" Or prefix3 = "019" Then
            matched = digits
        End If
    End If

    If matched = "" Then
        CheckBD = existing
    ElseIf existing = "" Then
        CheckBD = matched
    Else
        CheckBD = existing & ", " & matched
    End If
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 6. EXTRACT URL
' Usage: =XL_ExtractURL(A1)
' Example: "Visit our site https://www.google.com for info." -> "https://www.google.com"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ExtractURL(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim words() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim w As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim lw As String
    
    s = CStr(cell.Value)
    words = Split(s, " ")
    result = ""
    
    For i = 0 To UBound(words)
        w = Trim(words(i))
        lw = LCase(w)
        
        ' Check for http/https prefix or www prefix or common domain patterns
        Dim isURL As Boolean
        isURL = False
        
        If left(lw, 7) = "http://" Or left(lw, 8) = "https://" Then
            isURL = True
        ElseIf left(lw, 4) = "www." Then
            isURL = True
        ElseIf InStr(lw, ".com") > 0 Or InStr(lw, ".net") > 0 Or _
               InStr(lw, ".org") > 0 Or InStr(lw, ".io") > 0 Then
            ' Check it has a slash or dot structure (not just IP)
            If InStr(w, ".") > 0 And Len(w) > 5 Then
                ' Exclude plain IPs like 192.168.1.1
                Dim firstPart As String
                firstPart = left(w, InStr(w, ".") - 1)
                If Not IsNumeric(firstPart) Then
                    isURL = True
                End If
            End If
        End If
        
        If isURL Then
            ' Strip trailing punctuation
            Do While Len(w) > 0 And (right(w, 1) = "." Or right(w, 1) = "," Or right(w, 1) = ")")
                w = left(w, Len(w) - 1)
            Loop
            If result = "" Then
                result = w
            Else
                result = result & ", " & w
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    If result = "" Then
        XL_ExtractURL = "No URL found"
    Else
        XL_ExtractURL = result
    End If
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 7. AGE CALCULATOR FROM DATE OF BIRTH
' Usage: =XL_AgeFromDOB(A1)
' Example: Date serial or date value -> "25 Years 3 Months 12 Days"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_AgeFromDOB(cell As Range) As String
    Dim dob As Date
    Dim today As Date
    Dim years As Integer
    Dim months As Integer
    Dim days As Integer
    Dim tempDate As Date
    
    On Error GoTo InvalidDate
    
    dob = CDate(cell.Value)
    today = Date
    
    If dob > today Then
        XL_AgeFromDOB = "Future date!"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    years = DateDiff("yyyy", dob, today)
    If DateSerial(Year(today), Month(dob), Day(dob)) > today Then
        years = years - 1
    End If
    
    tempDate = DateAdd("yyyy", years, dob)
    months = DateDiff("m", tempDate, today)
    If DateAdd("m", months, tempDate) > today Then
        months = months - 1
    End If
    
    tempDate = DateAdd("m", months, DateAdd("yyyy", years, dob))
    days = DateDiff("d", tempDate, today)
    
    XL_AgeFromDOB = years & " Yrs " & months & " Mon " & days & " Days"
    Exit Function
    
InvalidDate:
    XL_AgeFromDOB = "Invalid Date"
End Function

' 8. NUMBER TO WORDS (Currency - Indian style)
' Usage: =XL_ConvertToWords(A1)
' Example: 1500 -> "One Thousand Five Hundred Only"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ConvertToWords(cell As Range) As String
    Dim num As Long
    Dim result As String

    On Error GoTo InvalidNum

    If IsEmpty(cell) Or Trim(cell.text) = "" Then
        XL_ConvertToWords = "No Value"
        Exit Function
    End If

    If Not IsNumeric(cell.Value) Then

    num = CLng(cell.Value)

InvalidNum:

End Function

Private Function NumToWords(ByVal num As Long) As String
    Dim ones(19) As String
    Dim tens(9) As String
    Dim result As String

    ones(0) = ""
    ones(1) = "One"
    ones(2) = "Two"
    ones(3) = "Three"
    ones(4) = "Four"
    ones(5) = "Five"
    ones(6) = "Six"
    ones(7) = "Seven"
    ones(8) = "Eight"
    ones(9) = "Nine"
    ones(10) = "Ten"
    ones(11) = "Eleven"
    ones(12) = "Twelve"
    ones(13) = "Thirteen"
    ones(14) = "Fourteen"
    ones(15) = "Fifteen"
    ones(16) = "Sixteen"
    ones(17) = "Seventeen"
    ones(18) = "Eighteen"
    ones(19) = "Nineteen"

    tens(0) = ""
    tens(1) = ""
    tens(2) = "Twenty"
    tens(3) = "Thirty"
    tens(4) = "Forty"
    tens(5) = "Fifty"
    tens(6) = "Sixty"
    tens(7) = "Seventy"
    tens(8) = "Eighty"
    tens(9) = "Ninety"

    result = ""

    If num >= 10000000 Then
        result = result & NumToWords(num \ 10000000) & " Crore "
        num = num Mod 10000000
    End If

    If num >= 100000 Then
        result = result & NumToWords(num \ 100000) & " Lakh "
        num = num Mod 100000
    End If

    If num >= 1000 Then
        result = result & NumToWords(num \ 1000) & " Thousand "
        num = num Mod 1000
    End If

    If num >= 100 Then
        result = result & ones(num \ 100) & " Hundred "
        num = num Mod 100
    End If

    If num >= 20 Then
        result = result & tens(num \ 10) & " "
        num = num Mod 10
    End If

    If num > 0 Then
        result = result & ones(num) & " "
    End If

    NumToWords = Trim(result)
End Function

Private Function ConvertToWords_Helper(ByVal num As Long) As String
    Dim ones() As String
    Dim tens() As String
    Dim result As String
    
    ones = Array("", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", _
                 "Eight", "Nine", "Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", _
                 "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen")
    tens = Array("", "", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety")
    
    result = ""
    
    If num >= 10000000 Then ' Crore
        result = result & ConvertToWords_Helper(num \ 10000000) & " Crore "
        num = num Mod 10000000
    End If
    
    If num >= 100000 Then ' Lakh
        result = result & ConvertToWords_Helper(num \ 100000) & " Lakh "
        num = num Mod 100000
    End If
    
    If num >= 1000 Then ' Thousand
        result = result & ConvertToWords_Helper(num \ 1000) & " Thousand "
        num = num Mod 1000
    End If
    
    If num >= 100 Then ' Hundred
        result = result & ones(num \ 100) & " Hundred "
        num = num Mod 100
    End If
    
    If num >= 20 Then
        result = result & tens(num \ 10) & " "
        num = num Mod 10
    End If
    
    If num > 0 Then
        result = result & ones(num) & " "
    End If
    
    ConvertToWords_Helper = Trim(result)
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 9. PASSWORD GENERATOR
' Usage: =XL_GeneratePassword(8)  <- length parameter
' Example: 12 -> "aB3#xK9@mL2!"
' Note: Volatile function - recalculates on every sheet change
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_GeneratePassword(length As Integer) As String
    Dim chars As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim charLen As Integer
    
    ' Character pool: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols
    chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%^&*"
    charLen = Len(chars)
    
    ' Validate length
    If length < 1 Then length = 8
    If length > 128 Then length = 128
    
    result = ""
    Randomize
    
    ' Ensure at least one of each type for passwords >= 4 chars
    If length >= 4 Then
        result = result & Mid("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", Int(Rnd() * 26) + 1, 1) ' uppercase
        result = result & Mid("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", Int(Rnd() * 26) + 1, 1) ' lowercase
        result = result & Mid("0123456789", Int(Rnd() * 10) + 1, 1)                  ' digit
        result = result & Mid("!@#$%^&*", Int(Rnd() * 8) + 1, 1)                    ' symbol
    End If
    
    ' Fill remaining length
    For i = Len(result) + 1 To length
        result = result & Mid(chars, Int(Rnd() * charLen) + 1, 1)
    Next i
    
    ' Shuffle the result (Fisher-Yates)
    Dim arr() As String
    ReDim arr(1 To Len(result))
    For i = 1 To Len(result)
        arr(i) = Mid(result, i, 1)
    Next i
    
    Dim j As Integer
    Dim temp As String
    For i = Len(result) To 2 Step -1
        j = Int(Rnd() * i) + 1
        temp = arr(i)
        arr(i) = arr(j)
        arr(j) = temp
    Next i
    
    result = ""
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
        result = result & arr(i)
    Next i
    
    XL_GeneratePassword = result
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 10. ADD SPACE (Fix CamelCase / PascalCase)
' Usage: =XL_AddSpace(A1)
' Example: "PowerPoint" -> "Power Point"
' Example: "MicrosoftExcel" -> "Microsoft Excel"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_AddSpace(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim c As String
    Dim prevC As String
    
    s = CStr(cell.Value)
    
    If Len(s) = 0 Then
        XL_AddSpace = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    result = left(s, 1)
    
    For i = 2 To Len(s)
        c = Mid(s, i, 1)
        prevC = Mid(s, i - 1, 1)
        
        ' Insert space before uppercase letter if previous was lowercase
        If c >= "A" And c <= "Z" Then
            If prevC >= "a" And prevC <= "z" Then
                result = result & " " & c
            ElseIf i < Len(s) Then
                ' Handle consecutive caps like "XMLParser" -> "XML Parser"
                Dim nextC As String
                nextC = Mid(s, i + 1, 1)
                If (nextC >= "a" And nextC <= "z") And (prevC >= "A" And prevC <= "Z") Then
                    result = result & " " & c
                Else
                    result = result & c
                End If
            Else
                result = result & c
            End If
        Else
            result = result & c
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Clean multiple spaces
    Do While InStr(result, "  ") > 0
        result = Replace(result, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    
    XL_AddSpace = Trim(result)
End Function

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' 11. REVERSE NAME (Last First -> First Last)
' Usage: =XL_ReverseName(A1)
' Example: "Sharma Rahul" -> "Rahul Sharma"
' Example: "Man Iron" -> "Iron Man"
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function XL_ReverseName(cell As Range) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim parts() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim result As String
    
    s = Trim(CStr(cell.Value))
    
    If Len(s) = 0 Then
        XL_ReverseName = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Remove extra spaces
    Do While InStr(s, "  ") > 0
        s = Replace(s, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    
    parts = Split(s, " ")
    
    If UBound(parts) = 0 Then
        ' Only one word, return as-is
        XL_ReverseName = s
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Reverse the parts array
    Dim left As Integer
    Dim right As Integer
    Dim temp As String
    left = 0
    right = UBound(parts)
    
    Do While left < right
        temp = parts(left)
        parts(left) = parts(right)
        parts(right) = temp
        left = left + 1
        right = right - 1
    Loop
    
    result = ""
    For i = 0 To UBound(parts)
        If result = "" Then
            result = parts(i)
        Else
            result = result & " " & parts(i)
        End If
    Next i
    
    XL_ReverseName = result
End Function

Sub GeneratePassword(control As IRibbonControl)
    ' Password needs a length input
    Dim length As Integer
    Dim userInput As String
    
    userInput = InputBox("Enter password length (6-64):", "Generate Password", "12")
    
    If userInput = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Not IsNumeric(userInput) Then
        MsgBox "Please enter a valid number.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    length = CInt(userInput)
    If length < 6 Then length = 6
    If length > 64 Then length = 64
    
    If Selection Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim cell As Range
    For Each cell In Selection
        If Not cell.HasFormula Then
            cell.Value = XL_GeneratePassword(length)
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' HELPER: Apply a formula to selected cells
' Puts formula in the next column if current cell has data,
' OR puts formula directly if cell is empty (yellow practice cells)
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub ApplyFormulaToSelection(formulaName As String)
    If Selection Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Please select a cell first.", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim targetCell As Range
    
    For Each cell In Selection
        ' If selected cell is empty, check if it's a formula target cell
        ' Put formula referencing the cell to the left
        If cell.Value = "" Or cell.Value = 0 Then
            ' Target cell is empty - put formula referencing left neighbor
            If cell.Column > 1 Then
                Set targetCell = cell
                targetCell.Formula = "=" & formulaName & "(" & cell.Offset(0, -1).Address(False, False) & ")"
            End If
        Else
            ' Selected cell has data - put formula in next column
            Set targetCell = cell.Offset(0, 1)
            targetCell.Formula = "=" & formulaName & "(" & cell.Address(False, False) & ")"
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub

        "INSTRUCTIONS:" & Chr(13) & _
        "1. Include HEADERS in the first row." & Chr(13) & _
        "2. Include the column you want to bulk export." & Chr(13) & _
        "3. Do not include merged cells.", _
        "Select Data for Bulk Export", _
        "", , , , , 8)

    On Error GoTo 0

    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Set g_DataRange = rng

    frmDataExporter.InitForm rng

    frmDataExporter.Show

End Sub

'=======================================================
' BUILD DASHBOARD
'=======================================================

Sub BuildSmartFilterDashboard(srcRange As Range, dashWs As Worksheet)

    Dim lastCol As Long
    Dim i As Long

    lastCol = srcRange.Columns.count

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    dashWs.Cells.Clear

    '===================================================
    ' TITLES
    '===================================================

    With dashWs.Range("B2")

        .Value = "1. Select Column"

        .Font.Bold = True

        .Font.Size = 11

    End With

    With dashWs.Range("F2")

        .Value = "2. Enter Search Text"

        .Font.Bold = True

        .Font.Size = 11

    End With


    '===================================================
    ' COMBOBOX
    '===================================================

    Dim cmb As OLEObject

    Set cmb = dashWs.OLEObjects.Add( _
                ClassType:="Forms.ComboBox.1", _
                left:=dashWs.Range("B3").left, _
                Top:=dashWs.Range("B3").Top, _
                Width:=170, _
                Height:=24)

    cmb.Name = "smartFilterCombo"

    Set gComboBox = cmb

    Dim cb As MSForms.ComboBox

    Set cb = cmb.Object

    For i = 1 To lastCol

        cb.AddItem srcRange.Cells(1, i).Value

    Next i

    cb.ListIndex = 0

    cb.Font.Size = 10


    '===================================================
    ' SEARCH BOX
    '===================================================

    Dim txt As OLEObject

    Set txt = dashWs.OLEObjects.Add( _
                ClassType:="Forms.TextBox.1", _
                left:=dashWs.Range("F3").left, _
                Top:=dashWs.Range("F3").Top, _
                Width:=180, _
                Height:=24)

    txt.Name = "smartSearchBox"

    txt.Object.Font.Size = 10

    Set gSearchBox = txt


    '===================================================
    ' EXPORT BUTTON
    '===================================================

    Dim shpBtn As Shape

    Set shpBtn = dashWs.Shapes.AddShape( _
                msoShapeRoundedRectangle, _
                dashWs.Range("J3").left, _
                dashWs.Range("J3").Top - 2, _
                80, _
                24)


    

    With shpBtn

    .Name = "smartExportBtn"

    .TextFrame.Characters.text = "Export as Excel"

    .Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(44, 62, 80)

    .TextFrame.Characters.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

    .TextFrame.Characters.Font.Bold = True

    .OnAction = "ExportSmartFilterData"

    End With






    '===================================================
    ' COPY DATA
    '===================================================

    dashWs.Range("B5").Resize( _
        srcRange.Rows.count, _
        srcRange.Columns.count).Value = srcRange.Value

    Dim dataRg As Range

    Set dataRg = dashWs.Range("B5").CurrentRegion

    Set g_DataRange = dataRg
    gLastSearchValue = ""


    '===================================================
    ' TABLE DESIGN
    '===================================================

    With dataRg

        .Font.Name = "Calibri"

        .Font.Size = 10

        .Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous

    End With

    .Font.Bold = True

    .Interior.Color = RGB(36, 64, 98)

    .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

    .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

    .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

    End With

    dataRg.Columns.AutoFit

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub


'=======================================================
' LIVE FILTER ENGINE
'=======================================================

Public Sub StartSmartFilterWatcher()

    On Error Resume Next

    If gSearchBox Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim currentText As String

    currentText = Trim(gSearchBox.Object.text)

    If currentText <> gLastSearchValue Then

        gLastSearchValue = currentText

        RunSmartFilter

    End If

    Application.OnTime _
        Now + TimeValue("00:00:01"), _
        "StartSmartFilterWatcher"

End Sub


'=======================================================
' APPLY FILTER
'=======================================================

Public Sub RunSmartFilter()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim filterCol As String
    Dim searchVal As String

    filterCol = Trim(gComboBox.Object.Value)

    searchVal = Trim(gSearchBox.Object.text)

    Dim filterIndex As Long
    Dim i As Long

    filterIndex = 0

    '-----------------------------------
    ' FIND COLUMN
    '-----------------------------------
    For i = 1 To g_DataRange.Columns.count

        If Trim(g_DataRange.Cells(1, i).Value) = filterCol Then

            filterIndex = i

            Exit For

        End If

    Next i

    If filterIndex = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    On Error Resume Next

    ' clear old filter
    If g_DataRange.Parent.FilterMode Then

        g_DataRange.Parent.ShowAllData

    End If

    ' apply filter
    If searchVal <> "" Then

        g_DataRange.AutoFilter _
            Field:=filterIndex, _
            Criteria1:="*" & searchVal & "*"

    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub


'=======================================================
' CLEAR FILTER
'=======================================================

Public Sub ClearSmartFilter()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    On Error Resume Next

    If g_DataRange.Parent.FilterMode Then

        g_DataRange.Parent.ShowAllData

    End If

    gSearchBox.Object.text = ""

    gLastSearchValue = ""

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


'=======================================================
' EXPORT FILTERED DATA
'=======================================================

Public Sub ExportSmartFilterData()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    ans = MsgBox( _
        "Do you want to export filtered data as separate Excel file?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "YES = Save XLSM file" & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = Create new worksheet", _
        vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, _
        "Export Filtered Data")

    If ans = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    Dim exportRg As Range

    On Error Resume Next

    Set exportRg = g_DataRange.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)

    On Error GoTo 0

    If exportRg Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "No filtered data found.", vbExclamation

        Exit Sub

    End If


    '===================================================
    ' EXPORT FILE
    '===================================================

    If ans = vbYes Then

        Dim fd As FileDialog
        Dim savePath As String

        Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)

        fd.Title = "Save Filtered File"

        fd.InitialFileName = _
            "FilteredData_" & Format(Now, "HHMMSS") & ".xlsm"

        If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

        Dim newWb As Workbook
        Dim newWs As Worksheet

        Set newWb = Workbooks.Add

        Set newWs = newWb.Sheets(1)

        exportRg.Copy

        newWs.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues

        newWs.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteFormats

        newWs.Cells.Columns.AutoFit

        Application.DisplayAlerts = False

        newWb.SaveAs _
            Filename:=savePath, _
            FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled

        Application.DisplayAlerts = True

        MsgBox "Filtered file exported successfully.", vbInformation

    Else

        '===================================================
        ' EXPORT TO NEW SHEET
        '===================================================

        Dim ws As Worksheet

        Set ws = Sheets.Add(After:=Sheets(Sheets.count))

        ws.Name = "Filtered_" & Format(Now, "HHMMSS")

        exportRg.Copy

        ws.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues

        ws.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteFormats

        ws.Cells.Columns.AutoFit

        MsgBox "Filtered data inserted into new sheet.", vbInformation

    End If

End Sub

'=======================================================
' RUN HIGHLIGHTER
'=======================================================

Sub RunSmartHighlighter()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Set ws = g_DataRange.Worksheet

    Dim searchTxt As String
    Dim selectedCol As String

    searchTxt = LCase(Trim(ws.OLEObjects("txtHighlightSearch").Object.text))

    selectedCol = Trim(ws.OLEObjects("cmbHighlight").Object.Value)

    Dim rw As Long
    Dim cl As Long

    g_DataRange.Offset(1).Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone

    If searchTxt = "" Then Exit Sub

    '====================================
    ' ALL COLUMNS
    '====================================

    If selectedCol = "All Columns" Then

        For rw = 2 To g_DataRange.Rows.count

            For cl = 1 To g_DataRange.Columns.count

                If LCase(g_DataRange.Cells(rw, cl).Value) Like "*" & searchTxt & "*" Then

                    g_DataRange.Rows(rw).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 120)

                    Exit For

                End If

            Next cl

        Next rw

    Else

        '================================
        ' SINGLE COLUMN
        '================================

        Dim filterCol As Long

        For cl = 1 To g_DataRange.Columns.count

            If Trim(g_DataRange.Cells(1, cl).Value) = selectedCol Then

                filterCol = cl

                Exit For

            End If

        Next cl

        If filterCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

        For rw = 2 To g_DataRange.Rows.count

            If LCase(g_DataRange.Cells(rw, filterCol).Value) Like "*" & searchTxt & "*" Then

                g_DataRange.Rows(rw).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 120)

            End If

        Next rw

    End If

End Sub


'=======================================================
' EXPORT HIGHLIGHTED DATA
'=======================================================
Sub ExportHighlightedData()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    ans = MsgBox( _
    "Do you want to save highlighted rows as a new Excel file?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
    "YES = Save as XLSM file" & vbCrLf & _
    "NO = Export to new sheet", _
    vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, _
    "Export Highlighted Data")

    If ans = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim exportWs As Worksheet

    Set ws = g_DataRange.Worksheet

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Set exportWs = Worksheets.Add(After:=Sheets(Sheets.count))

    exportWs.Name = "Highlighted_" & Format(Now, "HHMMSS")

    ' copy only highlighted rows
    g_DataRange.Rows(1).Copy exportWs.Range("A1")

    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim rw As Long
    Dim nextRow As Long

    lastRow = g_DataRange.Rows.count

    nextRow = 2

    For rw = 2 To lastRow

        If g_DataRange.Rows(rw).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 120) Then

            g_DataRange.Rows(rw).Copy _
            exportWs.Rows(nextRow)

            nextRow = nextRow + 1

        End If

    Next rw

    exportWs.Columns.AutoFit

    ' SAVE FILE
    If ans = vbYes Then

        Dim fPath As Variant

        fPath = Application.GetSaveAsFilename( _
        FileFilter:="Excel Macro Workbook (*.xlsm), *.xlsm")

        If fPath <> False Then

            exportWs.Parent.SaveAs fPath, 52

            MsgBox "Highlighted rows exported successfully!", vbInformation

        End If

    Else

        MsgBox "Highlighted rows exported to new sheet!", vbInformation

    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub


Sub LiveHighlightSearch()

    On Error Resume Next

    Dim currentTxt As String

    currentTxt = LCase(Trim( _
        g_DataRange.Worksheet.OLEObjects("txtHighlightSearch").Object.text))

    If currentTxt <> gLastSearchValue Then

        Application.ScreenUpdating = False

        gLastSearchValue = currentTxt

        RunSmartHighlighter

        Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    End If

    Application.OnTime _
        Now + TimeValue("00:00:01"), _
        "LiveHighlightSearch"

End Sub

'=======================================================
' RUN MASKING
'=======================================================

Sub RunSmartMasking()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Set ws = g_DataRange.Worksheet

    Dim selectedCol As String
    Dim maskType As String

    selectedCol = ws.OLEObjects("cmbMaskColumn").Object.Value

    maskType = ws.OLEObjects("cmbMaskType").Object.Value

    If maskType = "0. None (Original Data)" Then Exit Sub

    Dim rw As Long
    Dim cl As Long

    For rw = 2 To g_DataRange.Rows.count

        For cl = 1 To g_DataRange.Columns.count

            Dim hdr As String

            hdr = Trim(g_DataRange.Cells(1, cl).Value)

            If selectedCol = "All Columns" Or hdr = selectedCol Then

                g_DataRange.Cells(rw, cl).Value = _
                    GetMaskedValue( _
                    CStr(g_DataRange.Cells(rw, cl).Value), _
                    maskType)

            End If

        Next cl

    Next rw

End Sub


'=======================================================
' GET MASKED VALUE
'=======================================================

Function GetMaskedValue(txt As String, maskType As String) As String

    Dim result As String

    result = txt

    Select Case True

        '-----------------------------------
        ' FULL MASK
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Full Mask") > 0

            result = String(Len(txt), "*")


        '-----------------------------------
        ' NAME MASK
        ' sharif khandakar
        ' s***** k********
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Name Partial") > 0

            Dim parts() As String
            Dim finalName As String
            Dim i As Long

            parts = Split(txt, " ")

            finalName = ""

            For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)

                If Len(parts(i)) > 1 Then

                    finalName = finalName & _
                        left(parts(i), 1) & _
                        String(Len(parts(i)) - 1, "*") & " "

                Else

                    finalName = finalName & parts(i) & " "

                End If

            Next i

            result = Trim(finalName)


        '-----------------------------------
        ' MOBILE NUMBER
        ' +8801******89
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Mobile") > 0

            If Len(txt) >= 11 Then

                result = left(txt, 5) & _
                        String(Len(txt) - 7, "*") & _
                        right(txt, 2)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' EMAIL MASK
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Email") > 0

            Dim atPos As Long

            atPos = InStr(txt, "@")

            If atPos > 3 Then

                result = left(txt, 2) & "***" & Mid(txt, atPos)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' NATIONAL ID CARD
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "National") > 0

            If Len(txt) >= 4 Then

                result = "XXXX-XXXX-" & right(txt, 4)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' BANK CARD
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Bank Card") > 0

            If Len(txt) >= 4 Then

                result = "**** **** **** " & right(txt, 4)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' BANK ACCOUNT
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Bank Account") > 0

            If Len(txt) >= 4 Then

                result = "XXXXXX" & right(txt, 4)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' PASSPORT
        ' EH****567
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Passport") > 0

            If Len(txt) >= 5 Then

                result = left(txt, 2) & _
                        String(Len(txt) - 5, "*") & _
                        right(txt, 3)

            End If


        '-----------------------------------
        ' DATE OF BIRTH
        '-----------------------------------
        Case InStr(maskType, "Date") > 0

            result = "XX-XX-YYYY"

    End Select

    GetMaskedValue = result

End Function


'=======================================================
' EXPORT MASKED DATA
'=======================================================

Sub ExportMaskedDashboard()

    If g_DataRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    ans = MsgBox( _
        "Do you want to export masked data as PDF file?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "YES = Export as PDF" & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = Export to new Sheet", _
        vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion)

    If ans = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim exportWs As Worksheet

    Set ws = gMaskSheet

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    '-----------------------------------
    ' CREATE CLEAN EXPORT SHEET
    '-----------------------------------

    Set exportWs = Sheets.Add(After:=Sheets(Sheets.count))

    exportWs.Name = "MaskedExport_" & Format(Now, "HHMMSS")

    ' copy only table
    g_DataRange.Copy exportWs.Range("A1")

    exportWs.Columns.AutoFit

    '-----------------------------------
    ' PDF EXPORT
    '-----------------------------------

    If ans = vbYes Then

        Dim fPath As Variant

        fPath = Application.GetSaveAsFilename( _
            FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf")

        If fPath <> False Then

    With exportWs.PageSetup

        .Orientation = xlLandscape

        .Zoom = False

        .FitToPagesWide = 1

        .FitToPagesTall = False
        .PrintTitleRows = "$1:$1"

        .LeftMargin = Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

        .RightMargin = Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

        .TopMargin = Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

        .BottomMargin = Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

        .CenterHorizontally = True

    End With

        exportWs.Columns.AutoFit

        exportWs.ExportAsFixedFormat _
        Type:=xlTypePDF, _
        Filename:=fPath, _
        Quality:=xlQualityStandard

            MsgBox "PDF Export Complete!", vbInformation

        End If

    Else

        MsgBox "Masked data exported to new sheet.", vbInformation

    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

'=======================================================
' COLUMN CHANGE
'=======================================================

Private Sub cboSplitCol_Change()

    If cboSplitCol.ListIndex <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    lstUniqueItems.Clear

    Set m_UniqueItems = New Collection

    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim colIdx As Long
    colIdx = cboSplitCol.ListIndex

    Dim dataCol As Range
    Dim cell As Range

    Set dataCol = m_DataRange.Columns(colIdx)

    For Each cell In dataCol.Cells

        ' skip header
        If cell.Row > dataCol.Cells(1).Row Then

            Dim cleanVal As String

            cleanVal = Trim(CStr(cell.Value))

            cleanVal = WorksheetFunction.Trim(cleanVal)

            cleanVal = Replace(cleanVal, Chr(160), "")

            If cleanVal <> "" Then

                If Not dict.exists(LCase(cleanVal)) Then

                    dict.Add LCase(cleanVal), cleanVal

                    m_UniqueItems.Add cleanVal

                    lstUniqueItems.AddItem cleanVal

                End If

            End If

        End If

    Next cell

End Sub

'=======================================================
' EXPORT MAIN
'=======================================================

Private Sub ExportFilteredData(exportType As String)

    If cboSplitCol.ListIndex <= 0 Then

        MsgBox "Select a column.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub

    End If

    If lstUniqueItems.ListCount = 0 Then

        MsgBox "No unique items found.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Dim savePath As String
    Dim exportFolder As String

    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)

    With fd

        .Title = "Select Export Location"

        .InitialFileName = _
        ThisWorkbook.Path & "\Exported_Data"

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        savePath = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With

    exportFolder = left(savePath, _
    InStrRev(savePath, "\") - 1)


    Dim wsSource As Worksheet
    Set wsSource = m_DataRange.Worksheet

    Dim colIdx As Long
    colIdx = cboSplitCol.ListIndex

    Dim i As Long

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    For i = 0 To lstUniqueItems.ListCount - 1

        Dim uniqueVal As String
        uniqueVal = lstUniqueItems.List(i)

        Application.StatusBar = _
        "Exporting " & (i + 1) & _
        " of " & lstUniqueItems.ListCount & _
        " : " & uniqueVal

        m_DataRange.AutoFilter _
            Field:=colIdx, _
            Criteria1:=uniqueVal

        Dim visibleRng As Range

        On Error Resume Next

        Set visibleRng = _
        m_DataRange.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)

        On Error GoTo 0

        If visibleRng Is Nothing Then GoTo skipExport

        Dim wb As Workbook
        Set wb = Workbooks.Add

        Dim ws As Worksheet
        Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

        visibleRng.Copy

        ws.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteAll
        ws.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteColumnWidths

        Application.CutCopyMode = False

        ws.Cells.EntireColumn.AutoFit

        With ws.PageSetup

            .Orientation = xlLandscape
            .Zoom = False
            .FitToPagesWide = 1
            .FitToPagesTall = False

            .LeftMargin = _
            Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

            .RightMargin = _
            Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

            .TopMargin = _
            Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

            .BottomMargin = _
            Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

            .CenterHorizontally = True

        End With

        Dim saveName As String

        saveName = exportFolder & "\" & _
        CleanFileName(uniqueVal)

        If exportType = "PDF" Then

            ws.ExportAsFixedFormat _
                Type:=xlTypePDF, _
                Filename:=saveName & ".pdf", _
                Quality:=xlQualityStandard

            wb.Close False

        Else

            wb.SaveAs _
                Filename:=saveName & ".xlsx", _
                FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook

            wb.Close False

        End If

skipExport:

        Set visibleRng = Nothing

    Next i

    On Error Resume Next

    wsSource.ShowAllData

    Application.StatusBar = False

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox _
    exportType & " Export Completed Successfully.", _
    vbInformation

End Sub

    If lstUniqueItems.ListCount > 50 Then

    MsgBox _
    "Unique items exceeded 50." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
    "Please use Search + Remove button " & _
    "to reduce the list before creating sheets.", _
    vbExclamation

    Exit Sub

End If

    If cboSplitCol.ListIndex <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    colIdx = cboSplitCol.ListIndex

    Set wsSource = m_DataRange.Worksheet

        m_DataRange.AutoFilter _

skipSheet:

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox _
    "Sheets Created Successfully.", vbInformation

End Sub

'=======================================================
' CLEAN FILE NAME
'=======================================================

Private Function CleanFileName(f As String) As String

    Dim badChars As String

    badChars = "\/:*?""<>|"

    Dim i As Long

    For i = 1 To Len(badChars)

        f = Replace(f, Mid(badChars, i, 1), "_")

    Next i

    CleanFileName = Trim(f)

End Function

'========================================================
' BUILD DYNAMIC FIELDS
'========================================================
Private Sub BuildDynamicFields()

    Dim ctrl As control
    Dim arrTmp() As String

    Dim cnt As Long
    cnt = 0

    For Each ctrl In panelFields.Controls

        cnt = cnt + 1

        ReDim Preserve arrTmp(1 To cnt)

        arrTmp(cnt) = ctrl.Name

    Next ctrl

    Dim i As Long

    For i = 1 To cnt

        panelFields.Controls.Remove arrTmp(i)

    Next i

    Dim topPos As Single

    topPos = 8

    Dim lbl As MSForms.Label
    Dim txt As MSForms.TextBox
    Dim cbo As MSForms.ComboBox

    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        Set lbl = panelFields.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lbl_" & i)

        With lbl

            .Caption = m_Headers(i)

            .left = 8
            .Top = topPos + 3

            .Width = 100
            .Height = 18

            .Font.Bold = True
            .Font.Size = 9

        End With

        If IsDropdownColumn(i) Then

            Set cbo = panelFields.Controls.Add("Forms.ComboBox.1", "fld_" & i)

            With cbo

                .left = 115
                .Top = topPos

                .Width = 190
                .Height = 20

                .Style = fmStyleDropDownCombo

                .Font.Size = 9

            End With

            LoadUniqueValues cbo, i

        Else

            Set txt = panelFields.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "fld_" & i)

            With txt

                .left = 115
                .Top = topPos

                .Width = 190
                .Height = 20

                .Font.Size = 9

            End With

        End If

        topPos = topPos + 28

    Next i

    panelFields.ScrollBars = fmScrollBarsVertical
    panelFields.ScrollHeight = topPos + 30

'========================================================
' SMART DROPDOWN DETECT
'========================================================
Private Function IsDropdownColumn(colIdx As Long) As Boolean

    Dim h As String

    h = LCase(m_Headers(colIdx))

    If InStr(h, "status") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True
    If InStr(h, "category") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True
    If InStr(h, "city") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True
    If InStr(h, "state") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True
    If InStr(h, "region") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True
    If InStr(h, "type") > 0 Then IsDropdownColumn = True

End Function

'========================================================
' LOAD UNIQUE VALUES
'========================================================
Private Sub LoadUniqueValues(cbo As MSForms.ComboBox, colIdx As Long)

    Dim dict As Object

    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim r As Long
    Dim v As String

    For r = 1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1)

        v = Trim(CStr(m_OrigData(r, colIdx)))

        If v <> "" Then

            If Not dict.exists(v) Then
                dict.Add v, 1
            End If

        End If

    Next r

    Dim k

    For Each k In dict.Keys

        cbo.AddItem k

    Next k

End Sub

'========================================================
' EMPTY ARRAY CHECK
'========================================================
Private Function IsArrayEmpty(arr As Variant) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo errHandle

    If IsEmpty(arr) Then
        IsArrayEmpty = True
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim x As Long

    x = UBound(arr, 1)

    IsArrayEmpty = False

    Exit Function

errHandle:

    IsArrayEmpty = True

End Function

'========================================================

'========================================================
Private Sub txtSearch_Change()

    Dim s As String

    s = LCase(Trim(txtSearch.text))

    If s = "" Then

        m_FiltData = m_OrigData

        RenderDataList

        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim tempArr() As Variant

    ReDim tempArr(1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1), 1 To m_ColCount)

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim cnt As Long

    cnt = 0

    For r = 1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1)

        Dim found As Boolean

        found = False

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            If InStr(1, _
            LCase(CStr(m_OrigData(r, c))), s) > 0 Then

                found = True
                Exit For

            End If

        Next c

        If found Then

            cnt = cnt + 1

            For c = 1 To m_ColCount

                tempArr(cnt, c) = m_OrigData(r, c)

            Next c

        End If

    Next r

    If cnt = 0 Then

        lstData.Clear

        lblRowCount.Caption = "Total Records: 0"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    ReDim m_FiltData(1 To cnt, 1 To m_ColCount)

    For r = 1 To cnt

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            m_FiltData(r, c) = tempArr(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    RenderDataList

End Sub

'========================================================
' DATE FILTER
'========================================================
Private Sub ApplyDateFilter()

    If Trim(txtDateFrom.Value) = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Trim(txtDateTo.Value) = "" Then Exit Sub

    If Not IsDate(txtDateFrom.Value) Then

        MsgBox "Invalid FROM date."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    If Not IsDate(txtDateTo.Value) Then

        MsgBox "Invalid TO date."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim fromDt As Date
    Dim toDt As Date

    fromDt = CDate(txtDateFrom.Value)
    toDt = CDate(txtDateTo.Value)

    Dim dateCol As Long
    Dim i As Long

    ' detect date column
    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        If InStr(1, LCase(m_Headers(i)), "date") > 0 Then

            dateCol = i
            Exit For

        End If

    Next i

    If dateCol = 0 Then

        MsgBox "Date column not found."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim tempArr() As Variant

    ReDim tempArr(1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1), 1 To m_ColCount)

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim cnt As Long

    cnt = 0

    Dim rowDate As Date

    For r = 1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1)

        If IsDate(m_OrigData(r, dateCol)) Then

            rowDate = CDate(m_OrigData(r, dateCol))

            If rowDate >= fromDt _
            And rowDate <= toDt Then

                cnt = cnt + 1

                For c = 1 To m_ColCount

                    tempArr(cnt, c) = m_OrigData(r, c)

                Next c

            End If

        End If

    Next r

    If cnt = 0 Then

        lstData.Clear

        lblRowCount.Caption = "Total Records: 0"

        MsgBox "No records found."

        Exit Sub

    End If

    ReDim m_FiltData(1 To cnt, 1 To m_ColCount)

    For r = 1 To cnt

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            m_FiltData(r, c) = tempArr(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    RenderDataList

End Sub

'========================================================

'========================================================

'========================================================
' SORT
'========================================================
Private Sub btnSort_Click()

    Dim colIdx As Long

    colIdx = cboSortCol.ListIndex + 1

    Dim sortOrder As XlSortOrder

    If cboSortOrder.Value = "Descending" Then
        sortOrder = xlDescending
    Else
        sortOrder = xlAscending
    End If

    m_DataRange.Sort _
    Key1:=m_DataRange.Columns(colIdx), _
    Order1:=sortOrder, _
    Header:=xlYes

    LoadSheetData
    RenderDataList

End Sub

        Or TypeName(ctrl) = "ComboBox" Then

    Next ctrl

    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        Set ctrl = panelFields.Controls("fld_" & i)

    MsgBox "New data added."

'========================================================
' EXPORT EXCEL WITH FORMAT
'========================================================
Private Sub btnExportExcel_Click()

    Dim srcSheet As Worksheet
    Dim newBook As Workbook
    Dim newSheet As Worksheet

    Set srcSheet = ActiveSheet

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' create hidden workbook
    Set newBook = Workbooks.Add

    Set newSheet = newBook.Sheets(1)

    ' copy entire format
    srcSheet.Cells.Copy

    newSheet.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteFormats
    newSheet.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteColumnWidths

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long

    ' headers
    For c = 1 To m_ColCount

        newSheet.Cells(1, c).Value = m_Headers(c)

    Next c

    ' clear old rows
    newSheet.Rows("2:" & newSheet.Rows.count).ClearContents

    ' insert filtered data
    For r = 1 To UBound(m_FiltData, 1)

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            newSheet.Cells(r + 1, c).Value = _
            m_FiltData(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    Dim lastRow As Long

    lastRow = _
    newSheet.Cells( _
    newSheet.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).Row

    ' borders
    With newSheet.Range( _
    newSheet.Cells(1, 1), _
    newSheet.Cells(lastRow, m_ColCount)).Borders

        .LineStyle = xlContinuous

    End With

    newSheet.Cells.EntireColumn.AutoFit

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Dim savePath As String

    Set fd = _
    Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)

    fd.Title = "Save Excel File"

    fd.InitialFileName = _
    ThisWorkbook.Path & "\Report.xlsx"

    If fd.Show <> -1 Then

        newBook.Close False
        Exit Sub

    End If

    savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    If LCase(right(savePath, 5)) <> ".xlsx" Then

        savePath = savePath & ".xlsx"

    End If

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    newBook.SaveAs _
    Filename:=savePath, _
    FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook

    newBook.Close False

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Excel exported successfully."

End Sub

'========================================================
' EXPORT PDF WITH ORIGINAL FORMAT
'========================================================
Private Sub btnExportPDF_Click()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim srcSheet As Worksheet
    Dim tmpSheet As Worksheet

    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Dim savePath As String

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    Set srcSheet = ActiveSheet

    ' copy original sheet with formatting
    srcSheet.Copy After:=Sheets(Sheets.count)

    Set tmpSheet = ActiveSheet

    tmpSheet.Name = _
    "PDF_" & Format(Now, "hhmmss")

    lastCol = m_ColCount

    lastRow = _
    tmpSheet.Cells( _
    tmpSheet.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).Row

    ' remove old data rows but keep header
    If lastRow >= 2 Then

        tmpSheet.Range( _
        tmpSheet.Rows(2), _
        tmpSheet.Rows(lastRow)).EntireRow.Delete

    End If

    ' insert filtered data
    For r = 1 To UBound(m_FiltData, 1)

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            tmpSheet.Cells(r + 1, c).Value = _
            m_FiltData(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    lastRow = _
    tmpSheet.Cells( _
    tmpSheet.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).Row

    ' borders
    With tmpSheet.Range( _
    tmpSheet.Cells(1, 1), _
    tmpSheet.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Borders

        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlThin

    End With

    ' alignment
    With tmpSheet.Range( _
    tmpSheet.Cells(1, 1), _
    tmpSheet.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

    End With

    ' header style
    With tmpSheet.Rows(1)

        .Font.Bold = True

        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

    End With

    ' autofit
    tmpSheet.Cells.EntireColumn.AutoFit

    ' page setup
    With tmpSheet.PageSetup

        .Orientation = xlLandscape

        .Zoom = False

        .FitToPagesWide = 1
        .FitToPagesTall = False

        .PrintTitleRows = "$1:$1"

        .CenterHorizontally = True

        .LeftMargin = _
        Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

        .RightMargin = _
        Application.InchesToPoints(0.3)

        .TopMargin = _
        Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

        .BottomMargin = _
        Application.InchesToPoints(0.5)

    End With

    ' save dialog
    Set fd = _
    Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)

    fd.Title = "Save PDF"

    fd.InitialFileName = _
    ThisWorkbook.Path & "\Report.pdf"

    If fd.Show <> -1 Then

        tmpSheet.Delete

        GoTo SafeExit

    End If

    savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    If LCase(right(savePath, 4)) <> ".pdf" Then

        savePath = savePath & ".pdf"

    End If

    ' export pdf
    tmpSheet.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=savePath, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard

    tmpSheet.Delete

    MsgBox "PDF exported successfully."

SafeExit:

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:

    MsgBox Err.Description

    Resume SafeExit

End Sub

'========================================================
' INSERT DATA
'========================================================
Private Sub btnInsertData_Click()

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult

    ans = MsgBox( _
    "Do you want to insert preview data into a NEW worksheet?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
    "YES - Insert into New Sheet (Auto-Named)" & vbCrLf & _
    "NO - Insert into selected cell on Existing Sheet", _
    vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, _
    "Insert Preview Data")

    If ans = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    If ans = vbYes Then

        Call ExportToNewSheet

    ElseIf ans = vbNo Then

        Call InsertIntoExistingSheet

    End If

End Sub

'========================================================
' EXPORT TO NEW SHEET
'========================================================
Private Sub ExportToNewSheet()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim shtName As String

    Dim usingFilter As Boolean
    Dim usingTop As Boolean

    usingFilter = False
    usingTop = False

    '--------------------------------
    ' detect active operation
    '--------------------------------
    If cboFilterCol.Value <> "" And _
       cboFilterVal.Value <> "" Then

        usingFilter = True

    End If

    If cboTopN.Value <> "" And _
       txtTopCount.Value <> "" And _
       cboTopValCol.Value <> "" Then

        usingTop = True

    End If

    '--------------------------------
    ' SHEET NAME
    '--------------------------------
    If usingFilter Then

        shtName = _
        cboFilterCol.Value & "_" & _
        cboFilterVal.Value

    ElseIf usingTop Then

        shtName = _
        cboTopN.Value & _
        txtTopCount.Value & "_" & _
        cboTopValCol.Value

    Else

        shtName = "FilteredData"

    End If

    '--------------------------------
    ' remove invalid chars
    '--------------------------------
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "/", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "\", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, ":", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "*", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "?", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "[", "")
    shtName = Replace(shtName, "]", "")

    ' max 31 chars
    shtName = left(shtName, 31)

    '--------------------------------
    ' create sheet AFTER last sheet
    '--------------------------------
    Set ws = Worksheets.Add(After:=Worksheets(Worksheets.count))

    On Error Resume Next

    ws.Name = shtName

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

        ws.Name = shtName & "_" & Format(Now, "hhmmss")
        Err.Clear

    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

    '--------------------------------
    ' insert data
    '--------------------------------
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long

    ' header
    For c = 1 To m_ColCount

        ws.Cells(1, c).Value = m_Headers(c)

    Next c

    ' data
    For r = 1 To UBound(m_FiltData, 1)

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            ws.Cells(r + 1, c).Value = m_FiltData(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    '--------------------------------
    ' formatting
    '--------------------------------
    With ws.Range( _
        ws.Cells(1, 1), _
        ws.Cells(UBound(m_FiltData, 1) + 1, m_ColCount))

        .Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter

    End With

    ' header style
    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, m_ColCount))

        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(220, 230, 241)

    End With

    ws.Columns.AutoFit

    MsgBox "Data successfully inserted into new sheet.", vbInformation

End Sub
'========================================================
' INSERT INTO EXISTING SHEET
'========================================================
Private Sub InsertIntoExistingSheet()

    Dim rng As Range

    On Error Resume Next

    Set rng = Application.InputBox( _
    "Select starting cell", _
    "Insert Data", _
    Type:=8)

    On Error GoTo 0

    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long

    ' header
    For c = 1 To m_ColCount

        rng.Cells(1, c).Value = m_Headers(c)

    Next c

    ' data
    For r = 1 To UBound(m_FiltData, 1)

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            rng.Offset(r, c - 1).Value = m_FiltData(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    MsgBox "Data inserted into selected range."

End Sub


'========================================================
' DARK MODE
'========================================================

Private Sub btnDarkMode_Click()

    Dim ctrl As control

    isDarkMode = Not isDarkMode

    If isDarkMode Then

        ' DARK MODE
        Me.BackColor = RGB(35, 35, 35)

        For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

            Select Case TypeName(ctrl)

                Case "Frame"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(45, 45, 45)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbWhite

                Case "Label"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(35, 35, 35)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbWhite

                Case "TextBox", "ComboBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(55, 55, 55)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbWhite

                Case "ListBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(45, 45, 45)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbWhite

                Case "CommandButton"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbWhite

            End Select

        Next ctrl

        btnDarkMode.Caption = "Light Mode"

    Else

        ' LIGHT MODE
        Me.BackColor = RGB(240, 240, 240)

        For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

            Select Case TypeName(ctrl)

                Case "Frame"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(240, 240, 240)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbBlack

                Case "Label"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(240, 240, 240)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbBlack

                Case "TextBox", "ComboBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbBlack

                Case "ListBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbBlack

                Case "CommandButton"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = vbBlack

            End Select

        Next ctrl

        btnDarkMode.Caption = "Dark Mode"

    End If

End Sub

'========================================================
' TOP / BOTTOM ANALYSIS
'========================================================
Private Sub btnApplyTop_Click()

    If cboTopValCol.Value = "" Then

        MsgBox "Select value column."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim colIdx As Long
    Dim i As Long

    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        If m_Headers(i) = cboTopValCol.Value Then

            colIdx = i
            Exit For

        End If

    Next i

    If colIdx = 0 Then

        MsgBox "Column not found."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim topCount As Long

    topCount = val(txtTopCount.Value)

    If topCount <= 0 Then topCount = 5

    Dim tempArr() As Variant

    tempArr = m_FiltData

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim tempVal As Variant

    Dim maxRows As Long

    maxRows = UBound(tempArr, 1)

    ' simple bubble sort
    For r = 1 To maxRows - 1

        For c = r + 1 To maxRows

            If cboTopN.Value = "Top" Then

                If val(tempArr(r, colIdx)) < _
                val(tempArr(c, colIdx)) Then

                    SwapRows tempArr, r, c

                End If

            Else

                If val(tempArr(r, colIdx)) > _
                val(tempArr(c, colIdx)) Then

                    SwapRows tempArr, r, c

                End If

            End If

        Next c

    Next r

    If topCount > maxRows Then
        topCount = maxRows
    End If

    ReDim m_FiltData(1 To topCount, 1 To m_ColCount)

    For r = 1 To topCount

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            m_FiltData(r, c) = tempArr(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    RenderDataList

    MsgBox cboTopN.Value & _
    " records loaded."

End Sub
'========================================================
' SWAP ROWS
'========================================================
Private Sub SwapRows(arr As Variant, row1 As Long, row2 As Long)

    Dim i As Long
    Dim tmp As Variant

    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        tmp = arr(row1, i)

        arr(row1, i) = arr(row2, i)

        arr(row2, i) = tmp

    Next i

End Sub
'========================================================
' CONDITION FILTER
'========================================================
Private Sub btnApplyCondition_Click()

    If cboGTLTCol.Value = "" Then

        MsgBox "Select a column."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    If cboGTLTOp.Value = "" Then

        MsgBox "Select an operator."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    If Trim(txtGTLTVal.Value) = "" Then

        MsgBox "Enter condition value."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim colIdx As Long
    Dim i As Long

    For i = 1 To m_ColCount

        If m_Headers(i) = cboGTLTCol.Value Then

            colIdx = i
            Exit For

        End If

    Next i

    If colIdx = 0 Then

        MsgBox "Column not found."
        Exit Sub

    End If

    Dim compareVal As Double
    Dim op As String

    compareVal = val(txtGTLTVal.Value)

    op = cboGTLTOp.Value

    Dim tempArr() As Variant

    ReDim tempArr(1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1), 1 To m_ColCount)

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim cnt As Long

    Dim rowVal As Double
    Dim ok As Boolean

    cnt = 0

    For r = 1 To UBound(m_OrigData, 1)

        rowVal = val(m_OrigData(r, colIdx))

        ok = False

        Select Case op

            Case ">"
                ok = rowVal > compareVal

            Case "<"
                ok = rowVal < compareVal

            Case "="
                ok = rowVal = compareVal

            Case ">="
                ok = rowVal >= compareVal

            Case "<="
                ok = rowVal <= compareVal

        End Select

        If ok Then

            cnt = cnt + 1

            For c = 1 To m_ColCount

                tempArr(cnt, c) = _
                m_OrigData(r, c)

            Next c

        End If

    Next r

    If cnt = 0 Then

        lstData.Clear

        lblRowCount.Caption = _
        "Total Records: 0"

        MsgBox "No matching records found."

        Exit Sub

    End If

    ReDim m_FiltData(1 To cnt, 1 To m_ColCount)

    For r = 1 To cnt

        For c = 1 To m_ColCount

            m_FiltData(r, c) = _
            tempArr(r, c)

        Next c

    Next r

    RenderDataList

    MsgBox cnt & " records matched."

End Sub
Private Sub lstData_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)

    If KeyCode = vbKeyDown Then

        If lstData.ListIndex < lstData.ListCount - 1 Then
            lstData.ListIndex = lstData.ListIndex + 1
        End If

    End If

    If KeyCode = vbKeyUp Then

        If lstData.ListIndex > 0 Then
            lstData.ListIndex = lstData.ListIndex - 1
        End If

    End If

End Sub

VBA MACRO modAutoFileOrganizer.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modAutoFileOrganizer'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Sub RunAutoFileOrganizer()

    Dim sourceFolder As String
    Dim destinationFolder As String

    Dim fileAction As VbMsgBoxResult
    Dim startTime As Double

    Dim fso As Object
    Dim mainFolder As Object
    Dim oneFile As Object

    Dim ext As String
    Dim targetFolder As String
    Dim newFilePath As String
    Dim folderCategory As String

    Dim processedCount As Long
    Dim totalFiles As Long

    Dim wbReport As Workbook
    Dim wsReport As Worksheet
    Dim nextRow As Long

    startTime = Timer

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    '-----------------------------------
    ' STEP 1/3 - SOURCE FOLDER
    '-----------------------------------
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)

        .Title = "Step 1/3: Select SOURCE folder containing files"

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        sourceFolder = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With

    '-----------------------------------
    ' STEP 2/3 - DESTINATION FOLDER
    '-----------------------------------
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)

        .Title = "Step 2/3: Select DESTINATION folder for output"

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        destinationFolder = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With

    '-----------------------------------
    ' STEP 3/3 - MOVE / COPY
    '-----------------------------------
    fileAction = MsgBox( _
        "Step 3/3: How do you want to organize?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "YES = MOVE Files (Cut & Paste)" & vbCrLf & _
        "NO = COPY Files (Keep Originals)" & vbCrLf & _
        "CANCEL = Exit", _
        vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, _
        "Select Operation")

    If fileAction = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    Set mainFolder = fso.GetFolder(sourceFolder)

    totalFiles = mainFolder.Files.count

    '-----------------------------------
    ' CREATE REPORT WORKBOOK
    '-----------------------------------
    Set wbReport = Workbooks.Add
    Set wsReport = wbReport.Sheets(1)

    wsReport.Name = "Organization Report"

    wsReport.Range("A1:E1").Value = Array( _
        "Folder Name (Category)", _
        "File Extension", _
        "File Name", _
        "Action: Open File", _
        "Action: Open Folder")

    nextRow = 2

    '-----------------------------------
    ' PROCESS FILES
    '-----------------------------------
    For Each oneFile In mainFolder.Files

        ext = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(oneFile.Name))

        targetFolder = GetFolderByExtension(destinationFolder, ext)

        folderCategory = Mid(targetFolder, _
                             InStrRev(targetFolder, "\") + 1)

        If Not fso.FolderExists(targetFolder) Then
            fso.CreateFolder targetFolder
        End If

        newFilePath = targetFolder & "\" & oneFile.Name

        On Error Resume Next

        If fileAction = vbYes Then

            fso.MoveFile oneFile.Path, newFilePath

        Else

            fso.CopyFile oneFile.Path, newFilePath

        End If

        If Err.Number = 0 Then

            processedCount = processedCount + 1

            '---------------------------
            ' REPORT ENTRY
            '---------------------------
            wsReport.Cells(nextRow, 1).Value = folderCategory
            wsReport.Cells(nextRow, 2).Value = UCase(ext)
            wsReport.Cells(nextRow, 3).Value = oneFile.Name

            wsReport.Hyperlinks.Add _
                Anchor:=wsReport.Cells(nextRow, 4), _
                Address:=newFilePath, _
                TextToDisplay:="Click to Open File"

            wsReport.Hyperlinks.Add _
                Anchor:=wsReport.Cells(nextRow, 5), _
                Address:=targetFolder, _
                TextToDisplay:="Open Folder"

            nextRow = nextRow + 1

        End If

        Err.Clear
        On Error GoTo 0

    Next oneFile

    '-----------------------------------
    ' FORMAT REPORT
    '-----------------------------------
    With wsReport

        .Rows(1).Font.Bold = True
        .Rows(1).Interior.Color = RGB(90, 90, 90)
        .Rows(1).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

        .Range("A1:E" & nextRow - 1).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous

        .Columns.AutoFit

        .Rows(2).Select
        ActiveWindow.FreezePanes = True

        .Range("A1:E" & nextRow - 1).AutoFilter

    End With

    '-----------------------------------
    ' SAVE REPORT
    '-----------------------------------
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    wbReport.SaveAs _
        destinationFolder & "\Organization Report.xlsx"

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True

    '-----------------------------------
    ' DONE MESSAGE
    '-----------------------------------
    MsgBox "Done!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Files Processed: " & processedCount & _
           " / " & totalFiles & vbCrLf & _
           "Time: " & Format(Timer - startTime, "0.00") & " sec" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Professional Log Sheet Created.", _
           vbInformation, "Completed"

End Sub


Private Function GetFolderByExtension(basePath As String, _
                                      fileExt As String) As String

    Select Case fileExt

        Case "xlsx", "xls", "csv"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Excel Files"

        Case "pdf"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\PDF Files"

        Case "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "bmp"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Image Files"

        Case "doc", "docx"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Word Files"

        Case "ppt", "pptx"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\PowerPoint Files"

        Case "zip", "rar", "7z"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Compressed Files"

        Case "txt"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Text Files"

        Case "sql"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\SQL Files"

        Case "py"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Python Files"

        Case "mp4", "mkv", "avi"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Video Files"

        Case "exe"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Software Files"

        Case "json"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\JSON Files"

        Case "html", "htm"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\HTML Files"

        Case "js"
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\JavaScript Files"

        Case Else
            GetFolderByExtension = basePath & "\Other Files"

    End Select

End Function

VBA MACRO modSmartDataCleaner.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modSmartDataCleaner'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
