'==================================
' BROWSE FILE
'==================================
Private Sub btnBrowse_Click()

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim previewCols As Long

    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)

    With fd

        .Title = "Select Excel File"
        .Filters.Clear
        .Filters.Add "Excel Files", _
        "*.xlsx;*.xls;*.csv"

        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

        selectedFile = .SelectedItems(1)

    End With

    txtFilePath.Value = selectedFile

    lstPreview.Clear
    cmbDateColumn.Clear

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(selectedFile, ReadOnly:=True)
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    ' Date columns
    For c = 1 To lastCol

        If Trim(ws.Cells(1, c).Value) <> "" Then

            cmbDateColumn.AddItem _
                ws.Cells(1, c).Value

        End If

    Next c

    ' Preview setup
    If lastCol > 10 Then
        previewCols = 10
    Else
        previewCols = lastCol
    End If

    lstPreview.Clear
    lstPreview.ColumnCount = previewCols

    Select Case previewCols

        Case 1
            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = "120 pt"

        Case 2
            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = _
                "100 pt;100 pt"

        Case 3
            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = _
                "90 pt;90 pt;90 pt"

        Case 4
            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = _
                "80 pt;80 pt;80 pt;80 pt"

        Case 5
            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = _
                "80 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt"

        Case Else

            lstPreview.ColumnWidths = _
                "90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;" & _
                "90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt;90 pt"

    End Select

    ' Load preview
    For r = 1 To lastRow

        lstPreview.AddItem

        For c = 1 To previewCols

            On Error Resume Next

            lstPreview.List(r - 1, c - 1) = _
                ws.Cells(r, c).text

            On Error GoTo 0

        Next c

    Next r

    wb.Close False

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

Private Sub btnCleanData_Click()

   '=========================
    ' CHECK OUTPUT FOLDER
    '=========================
    If Trim(txtOutputFolder.Value) = "" Then

    MsgBox "Please select output folder first.", _
           vbExclamation, _
           "Output Folder Missing"

    txtOutputFolder.SetFocus
    Exit Sub

End If

    Dim wbSource As Workbook
    Dim wsSource As Worksheet

    Dim wbClean As Workbook
    Dim wsClean As Worksheet

    Dim cell As Range
    Dim rng As Range

    Dim rw As Long
    Dim cc As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim itemNo As Long

    Dim lastCol As Long
    Dim colIndex As Long

    Dim sym As String
    Dim savePath As String
    Dim dupCols() As Variant

    If Trim(txtFilePath.Value) = "" Then

        MsgBox "Please select a source file first.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub

    End If

    ' create output folder
    If Dir(txtOutputFolder.Value, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        MkDir txtOutputFolder.Value
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    Set wbSource = Workbooks.Open(txtFilePath.Value)
    Set wsSource = wbSource.Sheets(1)

    Set wbClean = Workbooks.Add
    Set wsClean = wbClean.Sheets(1)

    wsClean.Name = "Cleaned Data"

    wsSource.UsedRange.Copy
    wsClean.Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteAll

    Application.CutCopyMode = False

    lastCol = wsClean.Cells(1, wsClean.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    '========================
    ' TRIM EXTRA SPACES
    '========================
    If chkTrimSpaces.Value = True Then

        For Each cell In wsClean.UsedRange

            If VarType(cell.Value) = vbString Then
                cell.Value = Application.Trim(cell.Value)
            End If

        Next cell

    End If


    '========================
    ' TEXT CASE
    '========================
    If chkTextCase.Value = True Then

        For Each cell In wsClean.UsedRange

            If VarType(cell.Value) = vbString Then

                Select Case cmbTextCase.Value

                    Case "UPPER CASE"
                        cell.Value = UCase(cell.Value)

                    Case "lower case"
                        cell.Value = LCase(cell.Value)

                    Case "Proper Case"
                        cell.Value = StrConv(cell.Value, vbProperCase)

                End Select

            End If

        Next cell

    End If


    '========================
    ' REMOVE HYPERLINKS
    '========================
    If chkRemoveLinks.Value = True Then

        On Error Resume Next
        wsClean.Hyperlinks.Delete
        On Error GoTo 0

    End If


    '========================
    ' FORMULA TO VALUES
    '========================
    If chkFormulaToValues.Value = True Then

        wsClean.UsedRange.Value = _
            wsClean.UsedRange.Value

    End If



    '========================
' REMOVE SYMBOLS
'========================
If chkSymbols.Value = True Then

    Dim fullText As String
    Dim singleChar As String
    Dim x As Long

    If lstSymbols.ListCount > 0 Then

        For itemNo = 0 To _
            lstSymbols.ListCount - 1

            fullText = Trim( _
                lstSymbols.List(itemNo) & "")

            If fullText <> "" Then

                ' @#$% ??? ?? ?? ??? remove ????
                For x = 1 To Len(fullText)

                    singleChar = _
                        Mid(fullText, x, 1)

                    wsClean.Cells.Replace _
                        What:=singleChar, _
                        Replacement:="", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, _
                        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                        MatchCase:=False

                Next x

            End If

        Next itemNo

    End If

End If


'=========================
' FIND & REPLACE
'=========================
If chkFindReplace.Value Then

    Dim searchText As String
    Dim replaceText As String
    Dim txtCell As String

    searchText = Trim(txtFind.text)
    replaceText = Trim(txtReplace.text)

    ' nothing typed
    If searchText <> "" Then

        '=====================
        ' WHOLE WORD ONLY
        '=====================
        If chkWholeWordOnly.Value = True Then

            For Each cell In wsClean.UsedRange

                If Not IsError(cell.Value) Then

                    txtCell = Trim(CStr(cell.Value))

                    ' exact match only
                    If StrComp(txtCell, _
                               searchText, _
                               vbTextCompare) = 0 Then

                        cell.Value = replaceText

                    End If

                End If

            Next cell

        Else

            '=====================
            ' PARTIAL MATCH
            '=====================
            wsClean.Cells.Replace _
                What:=searchText, _
                Replacement:=replaceText, _
                LookAt:=xlPart, _
                SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                MatchCase:=False

        End If

    End If

End If

    '========================
    ' REMOVE DUPLICATES
    '========================
    If chkDuplicates.Value = True Then

        ReDim dupCols(1 To lastCol)

        For i = 1 To lastCol
            dupCols(i) = i
        Next i

        On Error Resume Next

        wsClean.UsedRange.RemoveDuplicates _
            Columns:=dupCols, _
            Header:=xlYes

        On Error GoTo 0

    End If


    '========================
    ' DELETE EMPTY ROWS
    '========================
    If chkEmptyRows.Value = True Then

        For rw = wsClean.Cells( _
            wsClean.Rows.count, 1) _
            .End(xlUp).Row To 2 Step -1

            If WorksheetFunction.CountA( _
                wsClean.Rows(rw)) = 0 Then

                wsClean.Rows(rw).Delete

            End If

        Next rw

    End If


    '========================
    ' DELETE EMPTY COLUMNS
    '========================
    If chkEmptyColumns.Value = True Then

        For cc = wsClean.Cells( _
            1, wsClean.Columns.count) _
            .End(xlToLeft).Column To 1 Step -1

            If WorksheetFunction.CountA( _
                wsClean.Columns(cc)) = 0 Then

                wsClean.Columns(cc).Delete

            End If

        Next cc

    End If


    '========================
    ' FILL TEXT BLANKS
    '========================
    If chkFillTextNA.Value = True Then

        For Each rng In wsClean.UsedRange

            If Trim(rng.text) = "" Then
                rng.Value = "N/A"
            End If

        Next rng

    End If


    '========================
    ' FILL NUMERIC BLANKS
    '========================
    If chkFillZero.Value = True Then

        For Each rng In wsClean.UsedRange

            If Trim(rng.text) = "" Then
                rng.Value = 0
            End If

        Next rng

    End If


    '========================
    ' CLEAR COLORS & FORMATTING
    '========================
    If chkClearFormatting.Value = True Then

        wsClean.Cells.ClearFormats

    End If


    '========================
    ' REMOVE COMMENTS
    '========================
    If chkRemoveComments.Value = True Then

        On Error Resume Next
        wsClean.Cells.ClearComments
        wsClean.Cells.ClearNotes
        On Error GoTo 0

    End If


    '========================
    ' DELETE OBJECTS / SHAPES
    '========================
    If chkDeleteShapes.Value = True Then

        On Error Resume Next

        Dim shp As Shape

        For Each shp In wsClean.Shapes
            shp.Delete
        Next shp

        On Error GoTo 0

    End If


    '========================
    ' FIX DATE FORMAT
    '========================
    If chkDateFormat.Value = True Then

        colIndex = 0

        For i = 1 To lastCol

            If Trim(wsClean.Cells(1, i).Value) = _
                Trim(cmbDateColumn.Value) Then

                colIndex = i
                Exit For

            End If

        Next i

        If colIndex > 0 Then

            wsClean.Columns(colIndex) _
                .NumberFormat = _
                cmbDateFormat.Value

        End If

    End If


    wsClean.Columns.AutoFit


'-----------------------
' SAVE FILE
'-----------------------
Dim outputFolder As String

outputFolder = Trim(txtOutputFolder.Value)

If outputFolder = "" Then
    outputFolder = "C:\CleanedData"
End If

' folder ?? ????? create
If Dir(outputFolder, vbDirectory) = "" Then
    MkDir outputFolder
End If

savePath = outputFolder & _
            "\Cleaned_" & _
            Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnnss") & _
            ".xlsx"

wbClean.SaveAs Filename:=savePath, _
               FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook

    wbSource.Close False

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "Data cleaned successfully!", _
        vbInformation

End Sub

Private Sub btnReset_Click()

    Dim ctrl As control

    '-------------------------
    ' UNCHECK ALL CHECKBOX
    '-------------------------

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "CheckBox" Then

            ctrl.Value = False

        End If

    Next ctrl


    '-------------------------
    ' RESET TEXTBOX
    '-------------------------
    txtFilePath.Value = _
        "Browse Excel file..."

    txtOutputFolder.Value = _
        "Browse export location..."

    txtFind.Value = _
        "Find value text"

    txtReplace.Value = _
        "Replace value text"

    txtSymbols.Value = _
        "Example: @#$%"


    '-------------------------
    ' RESET COMBOBOX
    '-------------------------
    cmbTextCase.ListIndex = -1
    cmbDateColumn.ListIndex = -1
    cmbDateFormat.ListIndex = -1

    cmbTextCase.text = _
        "Select Text Case"

    cmbDateColumn.text = _
        "Select Date Column"
    
    
    '-------------------------
' DATE FORMAT LIST
'-------------------------
cmbDateFormat.Clear

cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd-mm-yyyy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd/mm/yyyy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd-mm-yy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mm-dd-yyyy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mm/dd/yyyy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "yyyy-mm-dd"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "yyyy/mm/dd"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd-mmm-yyyy"
cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mmm-dd-yyyy"

    cmbDateFormat.text = _
        "Select Date Format"


    '-------------------------
    ' CLEAR LIST
    '-------------------------
    lstSymbols.Clear
    lstPreview.Clear


    '-------------------------
    ' SELECT ALL OFF
    '-------------------------
    chkSelectAll.Value = False

End Sub

'==================================
' DARK MODE
'==================================
Private Sub btnDarkMode_Click()

    Static isDark As Boolean
    Dim ctrl As control

    isDark = Not isDark

    If isDark Then

        ' DARK MODE
        Me.BackColor = RGB(35, 35, 35)

        For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

            Select Case TypeName(ctrl)

                Case "Label"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    ctrl.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent

                Case "Frame"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(45, 45, 45)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)

                Case "TextBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(55, 55, 55)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)

                Case "ComboBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(55, 55, 55)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)

                Case "ListBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(55, 55, 55)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)

                Case "CheckBox"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(35, 35, 35)

                Case "CommandButton"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)

            End Select

        Next ctrl

        btnDarkMode.Caption = "Light Mode"

    Else

        ' LIGHT MODE
        Me.BackColor = RGB(242, 242, 242)

        For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

            Select Case TypeName(ctrl)

                Case "Label"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
                    ctrl.BackStyle = fmBackStyleTransparent

                Case "Frame"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(242, 242, 242)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

                Case "TextBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

                Case "ComboBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

                Case "ListBox"

                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

                Case "CheckBox"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
                    ctrl.BackColor = RGB(242, 242, 242)

                Case "CommandButton"

                    ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

            End Select

        Next ctrl

        btnDarkMode.Caption = "Dark Mode"

    End If

End Sub

VBA MACRO frmDashboard.frm 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/frmDashboard'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Private mHeaderRow As Long

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()

    Me.Caption = "Power Dashboard Builder"

    With cmbThemeComboBox
        .Clear
        .AddItem "Ocean (Blue Light)"
        .AddItem "Midnight (Dark)"
        .AddItem "Slate (Dark Blue)"
        .AddItem "Forest (Green)"
        .AddItem "Rose (Pink)"
        .AddItem "Navy (Deep Blue)"
        .ListIndex = 1
    End With

    With cmbCurrencyComboBox
        .Clear
        .AddItem "None"
        .AddItem "Bangladesh (BDT)"
        .AddItem "India (INR)"
        .AddItem "Europe (EUR)"
        .AddItem "International (USD)"
        .ListIndex = 1
    End With

    With cmbGridlinesComboBox
        .Clear
        .AddItem "Show"
        .AddItem "Hide"
        .ListIndex = 0
    End With

        .Clear

        .ListIndex = 0
    End With

    txtTitleTextBox.text = "My Excel Dashboard"

    radiooptSingleOptionButton.Value = True
    chkSmartLockCheckBox.Value = True

    txtSheets.text = ""
    txtSheets.Visible = False

    txtRangeTextBox.text = ""
    txtRangeTextBox.Tag = ""

    mHeaderRow = 1

    UpdateDataSourceUI

End Sub

Private Sub radiooptSingleOptionButton_Click()
    UpdateDataSourceUI
End Sub

Private Sub radiooptMultiOptionButton_Click()
    UpdateDataSourceUI
End Sub

Private Sub UpdateDataSourceUI()

    txtRangeTextBox.Visible = True
    btnPickRangeCommandButton.Visible = True
    txtSheets.Visible = False

    txtRangeTextBox.text = ""
    txtRangeTextBox.Tag = ""

    txtSheets.text = ""
    mHeaderRow = 1

    If radiooptSingleOptionButton.Value = True Then
        lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
            "Click Pick and select any cell inside your data table."
    Else
        lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
            "Click Pick and select sheets."
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub btnPickRangeCommandButton_Click()

    If radiooptSingleOptionButton.Value Then
        PickSingleTableRange
    Else
        PickMultipleSheets
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub PickSingleTableRange()

    Dim selected_rng As Range
    Dim final_rng As Range

    Me.Hide
    DoEvents

    On Error Resume Next
    Set selected_rng = Application.InputBox( _
        prompt:="Click any cell inside your data table or select full range.", _
        Title:="Select Data Range", _
        Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If selected_rng Is Nothing Then
        lblStatusLabel.Caption = "No range selected."
        Me.Show
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If selected_rng.Areas.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "Please select one continuous range only.", vbExclamation
        Me.Show
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If selected_rng.Cells.count = 1 Then
        Set final_rng = selected_rng.CurrentRegion
    Else
        Set final_rng = selected_rng
    End If

    If final_rng.Rows.count < 2 Then
        MsgBox "Please include headers and at least one data row.", vbExclamation
        Me.Show
        Exit Sub
    End If

    txtRangeTextBox.Value = _
        final_rng.Worksheet.Name & "!" & _
        final_rng.Address(False, False)

    ' Workbook|Sheet|Range
    txtRangeTextBox.Tag = _
        final_rng.Worksheet.Parent.Name & "|" & _
        final_rng.Worksheet.Name & "|" & _
        final_rng.Address(False, False)

    lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
        "Range Selected: " & _
        final_rng.Rows.count - 1 & _
        " data rows"

    Me.Show

End Sub

Private Sub PickMultipleSheets()

    If ActiveWorkbook Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "No active workbook found.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    frmSheetPicker.Show vbModal

    If frmSheetPicker.WasCancelled Then

        lblStatusLabel.Caption = "No sheets selected."
        Unload frmSheetPicker
        Exit Sub

    End If

    txtSheets.text = frmSheetPicker.SelectedSheetIndexes
    mHeaderRow = frmSheetPicker.headerRow

    txtRangeTextBox.Tag = txtSheets.text

    txtRangeTextBox.text = _
        "Multi Sheet (" & _
        CountSelectedSheets(txtSheets.text) & _
        " selected)"

    lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
        CountSelectedSheets(txtSheets.text) & _
        " sheets selected"

    Unload frmSheetPicker

End Sub

Private Function CountSelectedSheets(ByVal sheetText As String) As Long

    If Trim(sheetText) = "" Then
        CountSelectedSheets = 0
    Else
        CountSelectedSheets = _
            UBound(Split(sheetText, ",")) + 1
    End If

End Function

Private Sub chkSmartLockCheckBox_Click()

    If chkSmartLockCheckBox.Value Then
        lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
            "Smart Lock enabled."
    Else
        lblStatusLabel.Caption = _
            "Smart Lock disabled."
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub btnCreateCommandButton_Click()

    Dim themeName As String
    Dim currencyName As String
    Dim dataInput As String

    If Trim(txtTitleTextBox.text) = "" Then
        MsgBox "Please enter dashboard title.", vbExclamation
        txtTitleTextBox.SetFocus
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If radiooptSingleOptionButton.Value Then

        If Trim(txtRangeTextBox.Tag) = "" Then
            MsgBox "Please select data range first.", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If

        dataInput = txtRangeTextBox.Tag
        mHeaderRow = 1

    Else

        If Trim(txtSheets.text) = "" Then
            MsgBox "Please select sheets first.", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If

        dataInput = txtSheets.text

    End If

    Select Case cmbThemeComboBox.ListIndex
        Case 0: themeName = "ocean"
        Case 1: themeName = "midnight"
        Case 2: themeName = "slate"
        Case 3: themeName = "forest"
        Case 4: themeName = "rose"
        Case 5: themeName = "navy"
        Case Else: themeName = "midnight"
    End Select

    Select Case cmbCurrencyComboBox.ListIndex
        Case 0: currencyName = ""
        Case 1: currencyName = "BDT"
        Case 2: currencyName = "INR"
        Case 3: currencyName = "EUR"
        Case 4: currencyName = "USD"
        Case Else: currencyName = ""
    End Select

    lblStatusLabel.Caption = "Creating dashboard..."
    btnCreateCommandButton.Enabled = False

    Me.Hide

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    CreateDashboard _
    Trim(txtTitleTextBox.text), _
    themeName, _
    currencyName, _
    radiooptMultiOptionButton.Value, _
    dataInput, _
    mHeaderRow, _
    chkSmartLockCheckBox.Value

    Unload Me
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:

    MsgBox "Dashboard create failed: " & Err.Description, vbCritical

    btnCreateCommandButton.Enabled = True
    lblStatusLabel.Caption = "Error creating dashboard."

    Me.Show

End Sub

Private Sub btnCancelCommandButton_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

VBA MACRO frmSheetPicker.frm 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/frmSheetPicker'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Public SelectedSheetIndexes As String
Public headerRow As Long
Public WasCancelled As Boolean

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()

    Dim i As Long

    WasCancelled = True
    SelectedSheetIndexes = ""
    headerRow = 1

    lstSheets.Clear

    For i = 1 To ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.count
        lstSheets.AddItem ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(i).Name
    Next i

    txtHeaderRow.text = "1"

End Sub

Private Sub btnOK_Click()

    Dim i As Long
    Dim result As String

    For i = 0 To lstSheets.ListCount - 1
        If lstSheets.Selected(i) Then
            If result <> "" Then result = result & ","
            result = result & CStr(i + 1)
        End If
    Next i

    If result = "" Then
        MsgBox "Please tick at least one sheet.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If val(txtHeaderRow.text) < 1 Then
        MsgBox "Header row must be 1 or more.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    SelectedSheetIndexes = result
    headerRow = CLng(val(txtHeaderRow.text))
    WasCancelled = False

    Me.Hide

End Sub

Private Sub btnCancel_Click()
    WasCancelled = True
    Me.Hide
End Sub

        New Collection

    For i = 1 To 42

        Set btnObj = _

        Set btnObj.Btn = _

'====================================
' CALENDAR
'====================================

Private Sub RenderCalendar()

    Dim firstDay As Date
    Dim startPos As Integer
    Dim daysInMonth As Integer

    Dim i As Long
    Dim d As Long

    Dim Btn As MSForms.CommandButton

    firstDay = _
        DateSerial( _
        currentYear, _
        currentMonth, 1)

    startPos = _
        Weekday(firstDay, _
        vbSunday)

    daysInMonth = _
        Day(DateSerial( _
        currentYear, _
        currentMonth + 1, 0))


    For i = 1 To 42

        Set Btn = _
            Me.Frame1.Controls( _
            "btnDay" & i)

        Btn.Caption = ""
        Btn.Enabled = False

        Btn.BackColor = _
            RGB(255, 255, 255)

    Next i


    d = 1

    For i = startPos _
        To startPos + _
        daysInMonth - 1

        Set Btn = _
            Me.Frame1.Controls( _
            "btnDay" & i)

        Btn.Caption = d
        Btn.Enabled = True

        If DateSerial( _
            currentYear, _
            currentMonth, d) _
            = selectedDate Then

            Btn.BackColor = _
                RGB(70, 180, 90)

        End If

        d = d + 1

    Next i

End Sub

Private Sub Load12HourList()

    Dim i As Long

    Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbHour").Clear

    For i = 1 To 12

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbHour").AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")

    Next i

End Sub


Private Sub Load24HourList()

    Dim i As Long

    Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbHour").Clear

    For i = 0 To 23

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbHour").AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")

    Next i

End Sub


Private Sub LoadCurrentTime()

    Dim h As Integer

    h = Hour(Time)

    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        If h = 0 Then
            h = 12
        ElseIf h > 12 Then
            h = h - 12
        End If

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbHour").Value = _
            Format(h, "00")

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbMeridian").Visible = True

        If Hour(Time) >= 12 Then

            Me.fraTime.Controls( _
                "cmbMeridian").Value = _
                "PM"

        Else

            Me.fraTime.Controls( _
                "cmbMeridian").Value = _
                "AM"

        End If

    Else

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbHour").Value = _
            Format(Hour(Time), "00")

        Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbMeridian").Visible = False

    End If


    Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbMinute").Value = _
        Format(Minute(Time), "00")

End Sub

'====================================
' PREVIEW
'====================================

Private Sub UpdatePreview()

    Dim h As Integer
    Dim m As Integer

    If Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbHour").Value = "" _
    Then Exit Sub

    If Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbMinute").Value = "" _
    Then Exit Sub


    h = val(Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbHour").Value)

    m = val(Me.fraTime.Controls( _
        "cmbMinute").Value)


    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        If Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbMeridian").Value _
            = "PM" _
        And h <> 12 Then

            h = h + 12

        End If


        If Me.fraTime.Controls( _
            "cmbMeridian").Value _
            = "AM" _
        And h = 12 Then

            h = 0

        End If

    End If


    selectedTime = _
        TimeSerial(h, m, 0)


    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            Format(selectedDate, _
            "dd-mmm-yyyy ") _
            & Format( _
            selectedTime, _
            "hh:mm AM/PM")

    Else

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            Format(selectedDate, _
            "dd-mmm-yyyy ") _
            & Format( _
            selectedTime, _
            "HH:mm")

    End If

End Sub


'====================================
' NOW BUTTON
'====================================

Private Sub btnNow_Click()

    selectedDate = Date

    currentMonth = _
        Month(Date)

    currentYear = _
        Year(Date)

    cmbMonth.ListIndex = _
        currentMonth - 1

    cmbYear.Value = _
        currentYear

    LoadCurrentTime

    RenderCalendar
    UpdatePreview

End Sub


'====================================
' APPLY
'====================================

Private Sub btnApply_Click()

    Dim c As Range
    Dim workRng As Range
    Dim finalDateTime As Date

    If TypeName(Selection) _
        <> "Range" _
    Then Exit Sub


    finalDateTime = _
        selectedDate + _
        selectedTime


    Set workRng = Selection


    For Each c In _
        workRng.Cells

        c.Value = _
            finalDateTime

        If opt12Hour.Value Then

            c.NumberFormat = _
                "dd-mmm-yyyy hh:mm AM/PM"

        Else

            c.NumberFormat = _
                "dd-mmm-yyyy HH:mm"

        End If

    Next c


    workRng.EntireColumn.AutoFit

    Unload Me

End Sub


Private Sub btnCancel_Click()

    Unload Me

End Sub

'==================================
' SMART RANGE
'==================================

Private Function GetSmartRange() _
    As Range

    Dim lastRow As Long

    If Selection.Columns.count = 1 _
    And Selection.Rows.count = _
    Rows.count Then

        lastRow = Cells( _
            Rows.count, _
            Selection.Column). _
            End(xlUp).Row

        Set GetSmartRange = _
            Range( _
            Cells(1, _
            Selection.Column), _
            Cells(lastRow, _
            Selection.Column))

    Else

        Set GetSmartRange = _
            Selection

    End If

End Function

VBA MACRO frmDateFormatStudio.frm 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/frmDateFormatStudio'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit


Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()

    Me.Caption = "Date Format Studio"

    cmbDateFormat.Clear

    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd-mm-yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mm-dd-yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "yyyy-mm-dd"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd/mm/yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mm/dd/yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd mmm yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd mmmm yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "mmm dd, yyyy"
    cmbDateFormat.AddItem "dddd, dd mmmm yyyy"

    cmbDateFormat.ListIndex = 0

    chkAutoApply.Value = True

    UpdatePreview

End Sub


Private Sub cmbDateFormat_Change()

    UpdatePreview

    If chkAutoApply.Value Then
        ApplyDateFormat
    End If

End Sub


Private Sub btnApply_Click()

    ApplyDateFormat

    Unload Me

End Sub


Private Sub btnCancel_Click()

    Unload Me

End Sub


Private Sub UpdatePreview()

    lblPreview.Caption = _
        Format(Date, cmbDateFormat.Value)

End Sub


Private Sub ApplyDateFormat()

    Dim workRng As Range
    Dim c As Range
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim dt As Date

    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub


    If Selection.Columns.count = 1 And _
       Selection.Rows.count = Rows.count Then

        lastRow = Cells(Rows.count, _
                    Selection.Column).End(xlUp).Row

        Set workRng = Range( _
            Cells(1, Selection.Column), _
            Cells(lastRow, Selection.Column))
    Else

        Set workRng = Selection

    End If


    On Error Resume Next

    For Each c In workRng.Cells

        If Trim(c.Value) <> "" Then

            dt = CDate(c.Value)

            If Err.Number = 0 Then

                c.Value = dt

                c.NumberFormat = _
                    cmbDateFormat.Value

                c.HorizontalAlignment = _
                    xlLeft

            End If

            Err.Clear

        End If

    Next c
    
    workRng.EntireColumn.AutoFit

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub

Private targetRange As Range

Private Sub LoadTimeFormats()

    cmbTimeFormat.Clear

    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        cmbTimeFormat.AddItem _
            "hh:mm AM/PM"

        cmbTimeFormat.AddItem _
            "hh:mm:ss AM/PM"

        cmbTimeFormat.ListIndex = 0

    Else

        cmbTimeFormat.AddItem _
            "HH:mm"

        cmbTimeFormat.AddItem _

        cmbTimeFormat.ListIndex = 0

    End If

'==============================

    UpdatePreview

    If chkAutoApply.Value Then

    End If

    UpdatePreview

    If chkAutoApply.Value Then
        ApplyTimeFormat
    End If

End Sub


Private Sub chkAutoApply_Click()

    If chkAutoApply.Value Then
        ApplyTimeFormat
    End If

End Sub


'==============================
' PREVIEW
'==============================

Private Sub UpdatePreview()

    Dim v As Variant
    Dim tm As Date

    If targetRange _
        Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    v = _
        targetRange.Cells(1, 1).Value

    If IsEmpty(v) Then

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            "No Time"

        Exit Sub

    End If


    On Error Resume Next

    ' Excel serial time support
    tm = TimeValue(CDate(v))

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            "Invalid Time"

        Err.Clear

    Else

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            Format( _
            tm, _
            cmbTimeFormat.Value)

    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


'==============================
' APPLY FORMAT
'==============================

Private Sub ApplyTimeFormat()

    Dim c As Range
    Dim tm As Date
    Dim v As Variant

    If targetRange _
        Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = _
        False

    For Each c In _
        targetRange.Cells

        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then

            v = c.Value

            On Error Resume Next

            tm = _
                TimeValue(CDate(v))

            If Err.Number = 0 Then

                c.Value = tm

                c.NumberFormat = _
                    cmbTimeFormat.Value

            End If

            Err.Clear
            On Error GoTo 0

        End If

    Next c

    Application.ScreenUpdating = _
        True

    UpdatePreview

End Sub


'==============================
' BUTTONS
'==============================
Private Sub btnApply_Click()

    ApplyTimeFormat

    Unload Me

End Sub


Private Sub btnCancel_Click()

    Unload Me

End Sub

VBA MACRO frmSmartTimePicker.frm

Option Explicit

Private selectedTime As Date


Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()

    Dim i As Long

    ' Hour
    cmbHour.Clear

    For i = 0 To 23
        cmbHour.AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")
    Next i


    ' Minute
    cmbMinute.Clear

    For i = 0 To 59
        cmbMinute.AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")
    Next i


    ' Meridian
    cmbMeridian.Clear
    cmbMeridian.AddItem "AM"
    cmbMeridian.AddItem "PM"


    ' Default format
    opt12Hour.Value = True
    opt24Hour.Value = False


    ' Current time
    LoadCurrentTime

    UpdatePreview

End Sub


'==================================
' LOAD CURRENT TIME
'==================================

Private Sub LoadCurrentTime()

    Dim h As Integer

    h = Hour(Time)

    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        If h = 0 Then
            h = 12
        ElseIf h > 12 Then
            h = h - 12
        End If

        cmbHour.Value = _
            Format(h, "00")

        cmbMeridian.Visible = True

        If Hour(Time) >= 12 Then
            cmbMeridian.Value = "PM"
        Else
            cmbMeridian.Value = "AM"
        End If

    Else

        cmbHour.Value = _
            Format(Hour(Time), "00")

        cmbMeridian.Visible = False

    End If


    cmbMinute.Value = _
        Format(Minute(Time), "00")

End Sub


'==================================
' FORMAT SWITCH
'==================================

Private Sub opt12Hour_Click()

    cmbHour.Clear

    Dim i As Long

    For i = 1 To 12
        cmbHour.AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")
    Next i

    cmbMeridian.Visible = True

    LoadCurrentTime
    UpdatePreview

End Sub


Private Sub opt24Hour_Click()

    cmbHour.Clear

    Dim i As Long

    For i = 0 To 23
        cmbHour.AddItem _
            Format(i, "00")
    Next i

    cmbMeridian.Visible = False

    LoadCurrentTime
    UpdatePreview

End Sub

    UpdatePreview

End Sub

    UpdatePreview

End Sub

    UpdatePreview

Private Sub UpdatePreview()

    Dim h As Integer
    Dim m As Integer
    Dim mer As String

    If cmbHour.Value = "" Then Exit Sub
    If cmbMinute.Value = "" Then Exit Sub


    h = val(cmbHour.Value)
    m = val(cmbMinute.Value)

    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        mer = cmbMeridian.Value

        If mer = "PM" _
        And h <> 12 Then

            h = h + 12

        End If

        If mer = "AM" _
        And h = 12 Then

            h = 0

        End If

    End If


    selectedTime = _
        TimeSerial(h, m, 0)


    If opt12Hour.Value Then

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            Format(selectedTime, _
            "hh:mm AM/PM")

    Else

        lblPreview.Caption = _
            Format(selectedTime, _
            "HH:mm")

    End If

End Sub


'==================================
' NOW BUTTON
'==================================

Private Sub btnNow_Click()

    LoadCurrentTime
    UpdatePreview

End Sub


'==================================
' APPLY
'==================================

Private Sub btnApply_Click()

    Dim workRng As Range
    Dim c As Range
    Dim lastRow As Long

    If TypeName(Selection) <> _
        "Range" Then Exit Sub


    If Selection.Columns.count = 1 _
    And Selection.Rows.count = _
    Rows.count Then

        lastRow = Cells( _
            Rows.count, _
            Selection.Column). _
            End(xlUp).Row

        Set workRng = _
            Range( _
            Cells(1, _
            Selection.Column), _
            Cells(lastRow, _
            Selection.Column))

    Else

        Set workRng = Selection

    End If


    For Each c In _
        workRng.Cells

        c.Value = selectedTime

        If opt12Hour.Value Then

            c.NumberFormat = _
                "hh:mm AM/PM"

        Else

            c.NumberFormat = _
                "hh:mm"

        End If

        c.HorizontalAlignment = _
            xlLeft

    Next c


    workRng.EntireColumn.AutoFit

    Unload Me

End Sub


Private Sub btnCancel_Click()

    Unload Me

End Sub

VBA MACRO modPowerDashboardEngine.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modPowerDashboardEngine'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

                           
Public Sub CreateDashboard(ByVal dashTitle As String, _
                           ByVal theme As String, _
                           ByVal currencyCodeCode As String, _
                           ByVal isMulti As Boolean, _
                           ByVal rangeOrSheets As String, _
                           ByVal startRow As Long, _
                           ByVal smartLock As Boolean)
    On Error GoTo CleanFail

    Application.StatusBar = "Power Dashboard: reading data..."

    Dim dataWb As Workbook
    Dim jsonData As String

    If isMulti Then

        Set dataWb = ActiveWorkbook

        If dataWb Is Nothing Then
            Err.Raise vbObjectError + 100, , _
                "No active workbook found."
        End If

        If dataWb Is ThisWorkbook Then
            Err.Raise vbObjectError + 101, , _
                "Please activate the workbook that contains your data, then run Power Dashboard again."
        End If

        jsonData = MultiSheetJSON(dataWb, rangeOrSheets, startRow)

    Else

        Dim rng As Range

        Set rng = ResolveRange(rangeOrSheets)

        If rng Is Nothing Then
            Err.Raise vbObjectError + 102, , _
                "Invalid data range: " & rangeOrSheets
        End If

        Set dataWb = rng.Worksheet.Parent
        jsonData = SingleRangeJSON(rng)

    End If

    If Len(jsonData) = 0 Or jsonData = "{}" Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 103, , _
            "No readable data found."
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = _
    "Power Dashboard: creating HTML..."

Dim htmlContent As String
Dim htmlPath As String
Dim ff As Integer

htmlContent = BuildDashboardHTML( _
                    jsonData, _
                    dashTitle, _
                    theme, _
                    currencyCodeCode, _
                    smartLock)

htmlPath = Environ$("TEMP") & "\power_dashboard.html"

ff = FreeFile

Open htmlPath For Output As #ff
Print #ff, htmlContent
Close #ff

If Dir(htmlPath) = "" Then
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 104, , _
        "Dashboard HTML file could not be created."
End If

Application.StatusBar = "Opening dashboard..."

On Error Resume Next

ThisWorkbook.FollowHyperlink htmlPath

If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    Err.Clear
    Shell "cmd /c start """" """ & htmlPath & """", vbHide
End If

On Error GoTo CleanFail

Application.StatusBar = False

MsgBox "Dashboard created successfully!", vbInformation

Exit Sub
CleanFail:

    Application.StatusBar = False

    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, _
        "Power Dashboard"

End Sub

Private Function ResolveRange(ByVal addressText As String) As Range

    On Error GoTo failSafe

    Dim parts() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    parts = Split(addressText, "|")

    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set wb = Nothing

    On Error Resume Next
    Set wb = Workbooks(parts(0))
    On Error GoTo failSafe

    If wb Is Nothing Then
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(parts(1))

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set ResolveRange = ws.Range(parts(2))
    Exit Function

failSafe:
    Set ResolveRange = Nothing

End Function

Private Function SingleRangeJSON(ByVal rng As Range) As String
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If rng.Rows.count < 2 Or rng.Columns.count < 1 Then Exit Function

    Dim headers() As String
    headers = HeadersFromRange(rng.Rows(1))

    Dim rowsJson As String
    rowsJson = RowsFromRange(rng.Offset(1, 0).Resize(rng.Rows.count - 1), headers)

    SingleRangeJSON = "{" & JsonQuote(rng.Worksheet.Name) & _
                      ":{" & JsonQuote("headers") & ":[" & JoinQuoted(headers) & "]," & _
                      JsonQuote("rows") & ":[" & rowsJson & "]}}"
End Function

Private Function MultiSheetJSON(ByVal wb As Workbook, ByVal sheetList As String, ByVal startRow As Long) As String
    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(sheetList, ",")

    Dim result As String
    Dim firstSheet As Boolean
    firstSheet = True
    result = "{"

    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)
        Dim sheetIndex As Long
        sheetIndex = val(Trim$(parts(i)))
        If sheetIndex >= 1 And sheetIndex <= wb.Worksheets.count Then
            Dim ws As Worksheet
            Set ws = wb.Worksheets(sheetIndex)

            Dim lastCol As Long
            Dim lastRow As Long
            lastCol = ws.Cells(startRow, ws.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).Column
            lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).Row

            If lastCol >= 1 And lastRow > startRow Then
                Dim dataRng As Range
                Set dataRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(startRow, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))

                Dim headers() As String
                headers = HeadersFromRange(dataRng.Rows(1))

                If Not firstSheet Then result = result & ","
                firstSheet = False
                result = result & JsonQuote(ws.Name) & _
                         ":{" & JsonQuote("headers") & ":[" & JoinQuoted(headers) & "]," & _
                         JsonQuote("rows") & ":[" & _
                         RowsFromRange(dataRng.Offset(1, 0).Resize(dataRng.Rows.count - 1), headers) & "]}"
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    MultiSheetJSON = result & "}"
End Function

Private Function HeadersFromRange(ByVal headerRow As Range) As String()
    Dim headers() As String
    ReDim headers(1 To headerRow.Columns.count)

    Dim c As Long
    For c = 1 To headerRow.Columns.count
        headers(c) = Trim$(CStr(headerRow.Cells(1, c).Value))
        If Len(headers(c)) = 0 Then headers(c) = "Column" & c
    Next c

    HeadersFromRange = headers
End Function

Private Function RowsFromRange(ByVal bodyRng As Range, ByRef headers() As String) As String
    Dim rowParts() As String
    ReDim rowParts(1 To bodyRng.Rows.count)

    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    For r = 1 To bodyRng.Rows.count
        Dim obj As String
        obj = "{"
        For c = 1 To bodyRng.Columns.count
            If c > 1 Then obj = obj & ","
            obj = obj & JsonQuote(headers(c)) & ":" & JsonValue(bodyRng.Cells(r, c).Value)
        Next c
        obj = obj & "}"
        rowParts(r) = obj
    Next r

    RowsFromRange = Join(rowParts, ",")
End Function

Private Function JoinQuoted(ByRef values() As String) As String
    Dim parts() As String
    ReDim parts(LBound(values) To UBound(values))

    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(values) To UBound(values)
        parts(i) = JsonQuote(values(i))
    Next i

    JoinQuoted = Join(parts, ",")
End Function

Private Function JsonValue(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsError(v) Or IsEmpty(v) Then
        JsonValue = "null"
    ElseIf IsDate(v) And Not IsNumeric(v) Then
        JsonValue = JsonQuote(Format$(CDate(v), "yyyy-mm-dd"))
    ElseIf IsNumeric(v) Then
        JsonValue = Trim$(Str$(CDbl(v)))
    Else
        JsonValue = JsonQuote(CStr(v))
    End If
End Function

Private Function JsonQuote(ByVal text As String) As String
    text = Replace(text, Chr$(92), Chr$(92) & Chr$(92))
    text = Replace(text, Chr$(34), Chr$(92) & Chr$(34))
    text = Replace(text, vbCrLf, "\n")
    text = Replace(text, vbCr, "\n")
    text = Replace(text, vbLf, "\n")
    JsonQuote = """" & text & """"
End Function

Private Function HtmlEncode(ByVal text As String) As String
    text = Replace(text, "&", "&amp;")
    text = Replace(text, "<", "&lt;")
    text = Replace(text, ">", "&gt;")
    text = Replace(text, """", "&quot;")
    HtmlEncode = text
End Function

Private pickedRange As Range

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()

    ' chart types
    With cmbChartType
        .AddItem "Column Chart"
        .AddItem "Bar Chart"
        .AddItem "Line Chart"
        .AddItem "Pie Chart"
        .AddItem "Doughnut Chart"
        .AddItem "Area Chart"
        .AddItem "Scatter Chart"
    End With

    ' themes
    With cmbTheme
        .AddItem "Light"
        .AddItem "Dark"
        .AddItem "Ocean"
        .AddItem "Midnight"
        .AddItem "Corporate"
    End With

    ' currency
    With cmbCurrency
        .AddItem "None"
        .AddItem "BDT (Tk)"
        .AddItem "$ USD"
        .AddItem "€ EUR"
        .AddItem "? INR"
    End With

    ' grid line
    With cmbGrid
        .AddItem "Show"
        .AddItem "Hide"
    End With

    ' default values
    cmbChartType.ListIndex = 0
    cmbTheme.ListIndex = 0
    cmbCurrency.ListIndex = 1
    cmbGrid.ListIndex = 0

    txtChartTitle = "Sales Chart"
    txtXAxis = "Category"
    txtYAxis = "Value"

    lblStatus.Caption = "Status: Ready"

End Sub


Private Sub btnPickData_Click()

    On Error Resume Next

    Set pickedRange = Application.InputBox( _
        prompt:="Select chart data range", _
        Title:="Pick Data", _
        Type:=8)

    If pickedRange Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    txtDataRange.text = _
        pickedRange.Worksheet.Name & "!" & pickedRange.Address

    lblStatus.Caption = _
        "Status: " & pickedRange.Rows.count & _
        " rows selected"

End Sub

    txtChartTitle = "Monthly Sales"
    txtXAxis = "Month"
    txtYAxis = "Sales"

    cmbChartType.Value = "Column Chart"
    cmbTheme.Value = "Ocean"
    cmbCurrency.Value = "? BDT"
    cmbGrid.Value = "Show"

    lblStatus.Caption = "Status: Demo loaded"

End Sub

    Unload Me

Private Sub btnCreateChart_Click()

    Dim result As VbMsgBoxResult

    If pickedRange Is Nothing Then

        MsgBox "Please select chart data first.", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub

    End If

    result = MsgBox( _
        "Create Interactive Web Chart?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Yes = HTML Web Chart" & vbCrLf & _
        "No = Excel Chart", _
        vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, _
        "Select Output")

    If result = vbCancel Then Exit Sub

    lblStatus.Caption = "Status: Creating chart..."

    ' YES = web chart
    If result = vbYes Then

    Call CreateWebChart( _
        pickedRange, _
        cmbChartType.Value, _
        txtChartTitle.text, _
        cmbTheme.Value, _
        txtXAxis.text, _
        txtYAxis.text)

    Else

    ' Excel chart
    CreateExcelChart

    End If

    lblStatus.Caption = "Status: Done"

End Sub

Private Sub CreateExcelChart()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim chartObj As ChartObject
    Dim chartKind As XlChartType
    Dim chartFontColor As Long
    Dim gridColor As Long

    Dim rangeText As String
    Dim sheetName As String
    Dim rangeAddress As String
    Dim splitPos As Long

    rangeText = txtDataRange.text

    splitPos = InStr(rangeText, "!")

    sheetName = left(rangeText, splitPos - 1)
    rangeAddress = Mid(rangeText, splitPos + 1)

    Set ws = Worksheets(sheetName)
    Set rng = ws.Range(rangeAddress)


    Select Case cmbChartType.Value

        Case "Column Chart"
            chartKind = xlColumnClustered

        Case "Bar Chart"
            chartKind = xlBarClustered

        Case "Line Chart"
            chartKind = xlLine

        Case "Pie Chart"
            chartKind = xlPie

        Case "Doughnut Chart"
            chartKind = xlDoughnut

        Case "Area Chart"
            chartKind = xlArea

        Case Else
            chartKind = xlColumnClustered

    End Select

    Set chartObj = ws.ChartObjects.Add( _
        left:=450, _
        Width:=520, _
        Top:=100, _
        Height:=300)

    With chartObj.Chart

    .chartType = chartKind

    ' clear default series
    Do While .SeriesCollection.count > 0
        .SeriesCollection(1).Delete
    Loop

    ' first column = label
    .SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    .SeriesCollection(1).XValues = rng.Columns(1)

    ' second column = value
    .SeriesCollection(1).values = rng.Columns(2)

    ' header name
    .SeriesCollection(1).Name = rng.Cells(1, 2).Value

    ' title
    .HasTitle = True
    .chartTitle.text = txtChartTitle.text
    .chartTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Size = 18
    .chartTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Bold = True

    ' axis title
    If chartKind <> xlPie And chartKind <> xlDoughnut Then

        .Axes(xlCategory).HasTitle = True
        .Axes(xlCategory).AxisTitle.text = txtXAxis.text

        .Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True
        .Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.text = txtYAxis.text

    End If

    ' legend
    .HasLegend = False

    ' smooth chart border
    .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    .PlotArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse

    ' grid line
    If cmbGrid.Value = "Hide" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        .Axes(xlValue).MajorGridlines.Delete
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        On Error Resume Next
        .Axes(xlValue).MajorGridlines.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(220, 220, 220)
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If

    ' ========= THEME =========

    Select Case cmbTheme.Value

    Case "Light"

        .ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        .PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(248, 249, 250)

        .SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(59, 130, 246)

        chartFontColor = RGB(30, 30, 30)
        gridColor = RGB(220, 220, 220)

    Case "Dark"

        .ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(24, 24, 24)
        .PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(38, 38, 38)

        .SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 200, 255)

        chartFontColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        gridColor = RGB(90, 90, 90)

    Case "Ocean"

        .ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(230, 244, 255)
        .PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(215, 235, 255)

        .SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 119, 182)

        chartFontColor = RGB(20, 50, 80)
        gridColor = RGB(180, 210, 230)

    Case "Midnight"

        .ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(18, 18, 35)
        .PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(25, 25, 50)

        .SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(123, 97, 255)

        chartFontColor = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        gridColor = RGB(80, 80, 120)

    Case "Corporate"

        .ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(248, 249, 250)
        .PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(240, 242, 245)

        .SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 91, 150)

        chartFontColor = RGB(35, 35, 35)
        gridColor = RGB(200, 205, 210)

End Select

    ' auto font color by theme
    .chartTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = chartFontColor

    On Error Resume Next

    .Axes(xlCategory).TickLabels.Font.Color = chartFontColor
    .Axes(xlValue).TickLabels.Font.Color = chartFontColor

    .Axes(xlCategory).AxisTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = chartFontColor
    .Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = chartFontColor

    If cmbGrid.Value = "Show" Then
    .Axes(xlValue).MajorGridlines.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = gridColor
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0



    ' rounded style feel
    .ChartArea.Format.Shadow.Visible = msoTrue

End With

    MsgBox "Excel chart created!", vbInformation

End Sub

VBA MACRO modSmartChart.bas 
in file: D:\Projects\XLSmart-Development\vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modSmartChart'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Public Sub CreateWebChart( _
    ByVal rng As Range, _
    ByVal chartType As String, _
    ByVal chartTitle As String, _
    ByVal themeName As String, _
    ByVal xAxisTitle As String, _
    ByVal yAxisTitle As String)

    Dim html As String
    Dim savePath As String
    Dim ff As Integer

    html = BuildChartHTML( _
        rng, _
        chartType, _
        chartTitle, _
        themeName, _
        xAxisTitle, _
        yAxisTitle)

    savePath = Environ$("TEMP") & "\smart_chart.html"

    ff = FreeFile

    Open savePath For Output As #ff
    Print #ff, html
    Close #ff

    ThisWorkbook.FollowHyperlink savePath

End Sub


Private Function BuildChartHTML( _
    ByVal rng As Range, _
    ByVal chartType As String, _
    ByVal chartTitle As String, _
    ByVal themeName As String, _
    ByVal xAxisTitle As String, _
    ByVal yAxisTitle As String) As String

    Dim labels As String
    Dim values As String
    Dim i As Long

    Dim bgColor As String
    Dim textColor As String
    Dim chartColor As String

    Dim h As String
    Dim isHorizontal As String

    ' data build
    For i = 2 To rng.Rows.count

        labels = labels & "'" & _
                 Replace(rng.Cells(i, 1).Value, "'", "") & "',"

        values = values & _
                 val(rng.Cells(i, 2).Value) & ","

    Next i

    If labels <> "" Then
        labels = left(labels, Len(labels) - 1)
    End If

    If values <> "" Then
        values = left(values, Len(values) - 1)
    End If


    ' theme
    Select Case themeName

        Case "Dark"

            bgColor = "#111827"
            textColor = "#FFFFFF"
            chartColor = "#00D4FF"

        Case "Ocean"

            bgColor = "#EAF6FF"
            textColor = "#0F172A"
            chartColor = "#0077B6"

        Case "Midnight"

            bgColor = "#0F172A"
            textColor = "#FFFFFF"
            chartColor = "#8B5CF6"

        Case "Corporate"

            bgColor = "#F3F4F6"
            textColor = "#111827"
            chartColor = "#005B96"

        Case Else

            bgColor = "#FFFFFF"
            textColor = "#111827"
            chartColor = "#2563EB"

    End Select


    ' chart map
    Select Case chartType

    Case "Column Chart"
        chartType = "bar"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Bar Chart"
        chartType = "bar"
        isHorizontal = "true"

    Case "Line Chart"
        chartType = "line"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Area Chart"
        chartType = "line"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Pie Chart"
        chartType = "pie"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Doughnut Chart"
        chartType = "pie"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Scatter Chart"
        chartType = "scatter"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case "Radar Chart"
        chartType = "radar"
        isHorizontal = "false"

    Case Else
        chartType = "bar"
        isHorizontal = "false"

End Select


    ' html start
    h = "<!doctype html><html><head>"
    h = h & "<meta charset='utf-8'>"
    h = h & "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'>"

    h = h & "<script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts/dist/echarts.min.js'></script>"

    h = h & "<title>" & chartTitle & "</title>"

    h = h & "<style>"
    h = h & "body{margin:0;background:" & bgColor & ";font-family:Segoe UI;overflow:hidden;}"

    h = h & ".top{padding:20px;color:" & textColor & ";}"
    h = h & ".top h1{margin:0;font-size:32px;font-weight:700;}"

    h = h & ".toolbar{padding:0 20px 15px;}"

    h = h & "button{background:" & chartColor & ";border:none;padding:10px 18px;"
    h = h & "border-radius:12px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;font-weight:600;}"

    h = h & "#chart{width:97%;height:92vh;margin:20px auto;"
    h = h & "background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}"

    h = h & "</style>"
    h = h & "</head><body>"

    h = h & "<div id='chart'></div>"

    h = h & "<script>"

h = h & "var chart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('chart'));"

h = h & "var option = {"

' animation
h = h & "animation:true,"
h = h & "animationDuration:1800,"
h = h & "animationEasing:'cubicOut',"

' title
h = h & "title:{"
h = h & "text:'" & chartTitle & "',"
h = h & "left:'center',"
h = h & "top:22,"
h = h & "textStyle:{"
h = h & "fontSize:34,"
h = h & "fontWeight:'700',"
h = h & "color:'" & textColor & "'"
h = h & "}"
h = h & "},"

' tooltip premium
h = h & "tooltip:{"
h = h & "trigger:'axis',"
h = h & "backgroundColor:'rgba(20,20,20,.92)',"
h = h & "borderRadius:18,"
h = h & "padding:[14,18],"
h = h & "textStyle:{fontSize:13,color:'#fff'}"
h = h & "},"

' right icons only
h = h & "toolbox:{"
h = h & "right:28,"
h = h & "top:22,"
h = h & "itemGap:12,"
h = h & "iconStyle:{borderColor:'#6C7BFF'},"
h = h & "feature:{"
h = h & "saveAsImage:{},"
h = h & "restore:{},"
h = h & "dataView:{show:false},"
h = h & "dataZoom:{}"
h = h & "}"
h = h & "},"

' grid
h = h & "grid:{"
h = h & "left:'6%',"
h = h & "right:'5%',"
h = h & "bottom:'12%',"
h = h & "top:'16%',"
h = h & "containLabel:true"
h = h & "},"

' x axis
h = h & "xAxis:{"

If isHorizontal = "true" Then
    h = h & "type:'value',"
Else
    h = h & "type:'category',"
    h = h & "data:[" & labels & "],"
End If
h = h & "name:'" & xAxisTitle & "',"
h = h & "nameLocation:'middle',"
h = h & "nameGap:50,"
h = h & "data:[" & labels & "],"
h = h & "axisLabel:{"
h = h & "color:'" & textColor & "',"
h = h & "fontSize:13,"
h = h & "fontWeight:'600'"
h = h & "},"
h = h & "nameTextStyle:{"
h = h & "color:'" & textColor & "',"
h = h & "fontWeight:'bold',"
h = h & "fontSize:16"
h = h & "},"
h = h & "axisLine:{"
h = h & "lineStyle:{color:'#A1A1AA'}"
h = h & "}"
h = h & "},"

h = h & "yAxis:{"

If isHorizontal = "true" Then
    h = h & "type:'category',"
    h = h & "data:[" & labels & "],"
Else
    h = h & "type:'value',"
End If
h = h & "name:'" & yAxisTitle & "',"
h = h & "nameTextStyle:{"
h = h & "color:'" & textColor & "',"
h = h & "fontWeight:'bold',"
h = h & "fontSize:16"
h = h & "},"
h = h & "axisLabel:{"
h = h & "color:'" & textColor & "'"
h = h & "},"
h = h & "splitLine:{"
h = h & "lineStyle:{"
h = h & "type:'dashed',"
h = h & "opacity:.25"
h = h & "}"
h = h & "}"
h = h & "},"

' series
h = h & "series:[{"

h = h & "data:[" & values & "],"
h = h & "type:'" & chartType & "',"

' line chart smooth
h = h & "smooth:true,"
h = h & "symbol:'circle',"
h = h & "symbolSize:8,"

' bar width
h = h & "barWidth:'56%',"

' line style
h = h & "lineStyle:{width:4},"

' area vibe for line chart
h = h & "areaStyle:{"
h = h & "opacity:.12"
h = h & "},"

' gradient color
h = h & "itemStyle:{"
h = h & "borderRadius:[16,16,0,0],"
h = h & "color:new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient("
h = h & "0,0,0,1,["
h = h & "{offset:0,color:'#4F8CFF'},"
h = h & "{offset:1,color:'#7C4DFF'}"
h = h & "])"
h = h & "},"

' hover
h = h & "emphasis:{"
h = h & "focus:'series',"
h = h & "scale:true"
h = h & "},"

' labels
h = h & "label:{"
h = h & "show:true,"
h = h & "position:'top',"
h = h & "fontWeight:'bold',"
h = h & "fontSize:12"
h = h & "}"

h = h & "}]"

h = h & "};"

h = h & "chart.setOption(option);"

h = h & "window.addEventListener('resize', function(){"
h = h & "chart.resize();"
h = h & "});"

h = h & "</script>"

    h = h & "</body></html>"

    BuildChartHTML = h

End Function

'=================================
' CHECK FOR UPDATES
'=================================
Public Sub Help_CheckUpdates(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim http As Object
    Dim responseText As String
    Dim latestVersion As String
    Dim downloadUrl As String

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")

    http.Open "GET", UPDATE_JSON_URL, False
    http.Send

    If http.Status <> 200 Then

        MsgBox "Unable to check updates right now.", _
               vbExclamation, _
               "XLSmart"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    responseText = http.responseText

    latestVersion = GetJsonValue(responseText, "version")
    downloadUrl = GetJsonValue(responseText, "download_url")

    If latestVersion = APP_VERSION Then

        MsgBox "You are already using the latest version of XLSmart (" & _
               APP_VERSION & ").", _
               vbInformation, _
               "XLSmart"

    Else

        If MsgBox( _
            "New XLSmart update available!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Current Version: " & APP_VERSION & vbCrLf & _
            "Latest Version: " & latestVersion & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Do you want to update now?", _
            vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
            "XLSmart Update") = vbYes Then

            ThisWorkbook.FollowHyperlink downloadUrl

        End If

    End If

    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:

    MsgBox "Internet connection or update server problem.", _
           vbExclamation, _
           "XLSmart"

End Sub


Private Function GetJsonValue(jsonText As String, key As String) As String

    Dim startPos As Long
    Dim endPos As Long
    Dim searchKey As String
    Dim cleanText As String

    ' remove line breaks and spaces
    cleanText = Replace(jsonText, vbCr, "")
    cleanText = Replace(cleanText, vbLf, "")
    cleanText = Replace(cleanText, " ", "")

    searchKey = """" & key & """:"""

    startPos = InStr(cleanText, searchKey)

    If startPos = 0 Then Exit Function

    startPos = startPos + Len(searchKey)

    If Mid(cleanText, startPos, 1) = """" Then
        startPos = startPos + 1
    End If

    endPos = InStr(startPos, cleanText, """")

    If endPos > startPos Then
        GetJsonValue = Mid(cleanText, startPos, endPos - startPos)
    End If

End Function

'=================================
' UNINSTALL XLSMART
'=================================
Public Sub Help_Uninstall(control As IRibbonControl)

    Dim ans As VbMsgBoxResult
    Dim i As Long
    Dim addinPath As String
    Dim wbName As String

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    wbName = "XLSmart_User"

    ans = MsgBox( _
        "Are you sure you want to uninstall XLSmart?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Excel will restart after uninstall.", _
        vbYesNo + vbQuestion, _
        "Uninstall XLSmart")

    If ans = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    addinPath = Environ$("APPDATA") & _
                "\Microsoft\AddIns\XLSmart_User.xlam"

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    ' disable addin
    For i = AddIns.count To 1 Step -1

        If LCase(AddIns(i).Name) = _
           LCase("XLSmart_User.xlam") Then

            AddIns(i).Installed = False

            ' remove from addins list
            AddIns(i).Delete

            Exit For

        End If

    Next i

    ' delete physical file
    If Dir(addinPath) <> "" Then
        Kill addinPath
    End If

    MsgBox "XLSmart removed successfully." & vbCrLf & _
           "Excel will now close.", _
           vbInformation, _
           "XLSmart"

    Application.Quit

    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:

    MsgBox "Uninstall failed:" & vbCrLf & _
           Err.Description, _
           vbCritical, _
           "XLSmart"

End Sub
